400: Veyisgun beh. begin denishmatin la nafke lealma, ela behay berit. vechen nagozu, hay im shelemim denatre leh tadir, nagozu man deitgezar vekibbel aleh keyayma da. veavar, may veavar. hahu zuhama dearla, dehava beh bekadmita.

Davar acher, ko amar Adonai im shelemim vechen rabbim, illen beni yaakov. deha kol zimna dehavu legabbeh deyosef, inun shelemim, dekayyme bahadeh divrit. vechen nagozu, deazlu veshavku leh leyosef uleshimon. veavar, keden dina sharya beginayyhu (nusach acher shechinta sharyay benayyhu), kema deat amer, (Shemot 12:23) veavar Adonai lingof et mitzrayim.
Ta chaze, it dina kashya, veit dina rafya. dina kashya takkif, dina rafya chalash, vechad yanka hay dina rafya, middina kashya, keden ittakkaf, veihu takkif.

Beshata deitavid dina al yisrael, itavid behay dina rafya, vela ittakkaf behahu dina kashya. vechad dina itavid alayyhu deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, ittakkaf hay dina rafya, bedina kashya dilela, begin leittakfa. hada hu dichtiv, veavar Adonai lingof et mitzrayim. veavar, deitmele evra vezaama, veittakkaf bedina kashya, uf hacha veavar. veta chaze, beshata demitkanneshe asara beve kenishta, vechad minnayyhu ishtemit, keden kudesha berich hu argiz aleh.

Davar acher vechen nagozu, kad mitabbere minnayyhu inun ovadin bishin, keden veavar. may veavar, ribbi shimon amar, bezimna denishmata nafkat mehay alma, bechamma dinin itdanat ad la tiul leatrah. levatar, kol inun nishmatin it lon lemeevar, behach nehar dinur denagid venafik, uleistachaa tamman. uman ihu deyakum tamman, veyaavar bela dechilu. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 24:3) mi yaale behar Adonai vegomer. venishmata dezakkaa aavar bela dechilu veyakum bimkom kadsho.

Uman deishtaddal bitzdaka behay alma, veyitten mimmamoneh bitzdaka. keden, veavar behahu atar, vela dachil, vecharoza kare lah lehahi nishmata, (Nachum 1:12) veinniticha lo aannech od. man dezacha lemeevar behay, let leh dina yattir kelal.

Ta chaze, kol da deyosef im achoy, vechol hanni mile, ammay itzterich. ella orayyta dikshot ihi orayyta, vechol archaha archin kaddishin. velet lach milla beorayyta delav it bah razin illain vekaddishin, vearchin livne nasha leittakfa behu.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 20:22) al tomar ashallema ra vegomer. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avid leh levar nash, leittakfa bah beorayyta, ulemehach beorach keshot, velistar yemina, vela yehach listar semala. uvegin devae lehu (deyisrael) lemehach listar yemina, it lon leasgaa rechimu da im da, vela yehe devavu da im da. begin dela leakkechasha yemina, deihu atar deyisrael mitdabbekan beh.

Veta chaze, vegin kach ihu yetzer tov veyetzer ra, veyisrael bayayn leittakfa leyetzer tov al yetzer ra, beinun ovadin dechashran, vei sate bar nash lismala, keden ittakkaf yetzer ra al yetzer tov. uman dehava pagim, ashlim leh bechetoy, deha la ishtallim da menuvala, ella bechetin divne nasha.

Uvegin kach bae bar nash leizdahara, dela yishtallim hahu yetzer ra bechetoy, veyistammar tadir. deha yetzer tov bae leashlama leh bishlemut tadir, velo yetzer hara. uvegin kach, al tomar ashallema ra kave el Adonai veyosha lach.

Davar acher al tomar ashallema ra, kedichtiv, (Tehillim 38:21) umeshalleme raa tachat tova, leman deshallim leh tova, delo yashlem leh ra, begin (dechilu dekudesha berich hu. kema deat amar, zot asu vichyu. veuf ihu have tadir avid) dichtiv, (Mishlei 17:13) meshiv raa tachat tova lo tamush raa mibbeto. afillu leman deashlimu leh bishin, la it leh leashlama bisha, chalaf hahu visha deshallimu leh. ella, kavve laAdonai veyosha lach.
Vehay kera ukemuha, beyosef zakkaa, dela baa leashlama bisha laachoy, beshata denaflu bidoy. kavve laAdonai veyosha lach, begin dehu hava
401: Dachil lekudesha berich hu. dichtiv, zot asu vichyu vegomer. (veuf) veihu tadir hava mechakke lekudesha berich hu. (sefer acher kema deat amar, kavve laAdonai vayyosha lecha).

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Mishlei 20:Adonai) mayim amukim etza belev ish veish tevuna yidlenna. mayim amukim etza belev ish, da kudesha berich hu. begin deihu avid etzot, deayyte taamin legalgela gilgulin al alma al yeda deyosef, lekayyma hahu gezera, degazar kafna al ara (nusach acher alma). veish tevuna yidlenna, da yosef. degale inun amikin, degazar kudesha berich hu al alma.
Ta chaze, yosef lo day leh deihu la shallim bisha laachoy, ela deavad immehon tivu ukeshot. vechach archehon dezakkae tadir. begin da kudesha berich hu chayis alayyhu tadir, bealma den uvealma deate.
Mayim amukim etza belev ish, da yehuda. veha ukemuha, beshata deitkariv legabbeh deyosef, al iska devinyamin. veish tevuna yidlenna, da yosef.

Ribbi abba hava yativ atara deabbava delod, chama chad bar nash dehava ate, veyativ bechad kuleta detala deara, vehava lae mearcha, veyativ venaim tamman. addehachi chame chad chivya, dehava ate legabbeh, nafak kostefa deguredna, vekatil leh lechivya. kad itar hahu bar nash, chama hahu chivya lekovleh, dehava mit. izdakkaf hahu bar nash, venafal hahu kuleta leumeka ditchotoy veishteziv.
Ata ribbi abba legabbeh, amar leh, ema li man ovadach. deha kudesha berich hu rachish lach illen teren nissin, lav inun lemaggana.

Amar leh hahu bar nash, kol yomay la ashlim li bar nash bisha bealma, dela itpayyaysna bahadeh, umachilna leh. vetu, i la yachilna leitpayysa bahadeh, la salikna learsi, ad demachilna leh, ulechol inun dimtzaaru li, vela chayyshana kol yoma lehahu bisha deashlim li. velav di li da, ella dimhahu yoma ulehala, ishtaddalna lemebad immehon tava.

Bacha ribbi abba veamar, yattir ovadoy deden miyyosef, deyosef havu achoy vadday, vehava leh lerachama aloy. aval ma deavid da, yattir hu miyyosef. yaot hu dekudesha berich hu yarchish leh nissa al nissa.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 10:9) holech battom yelech betach umeakkesh derachav yivvadea. holech battom yelech betach, da hahu bar nash, deazil bearchin deorayyta. yelech betach, dela yachilu nizke dealma leavasha leh. umeakkesh derachav yivvadea, man yivvadea. da hu man deaste mearcha dikshot, uvae gabbe dechavreh. yivvadea, mahu yivvadea, yishtemoda ihu beenehon dechol mare dedina, dela yitavid minnayyhu diukena dehahu bar nash. begin leayytaa leh leatra deyinkemun minneh, uvegin kach yivvadea.

Veta chaze, hahu deazil beorach keshot, kudesha berich hu chafe aleh, begin dela ityeda, vela ishtemoda, legabbe marehon dedina. aval meakkesh derachav yivvadea, veyishtemoda legabbayyhu. zakkain inun bene nasha deazle beorach keshot, veazle lerochatzan al alma. dela dachale inun bealma den, vela bealma deate:

Vayyiru haanashim ki huveu bet yosef. ribbi yose amar, vavy lon livne nasha, dela yade vela mistakkelin bearche deorayyta. vavy lon beshata dekudesha berich hu yete lemitba lon dina al ovadehon, veyakum gufa venafsha lemehav chushebana mikkol ovadehon, ad la yitparshun nafsha min gufa.

Vehahu yoma, yoma dedina ihu, yoma desifrin petichan, umarehon dedina kayymin. begin dehahu zimna, kayyma nachash bekiyyumeh, lenashcha leh. vechol shayyfe mitraggeshin legabbeh, venishmata itparsha min gufa, veazla veshatya. vela yadat lean archa tehach, ulean atar salkin lah.

Vavy lehahu yoma, yoma derugeza uneitzu hahu yoma, vegin kach ibbae leh levar nash, leargaza yitzreh kol yoma, leadkara kammeh hahu yoma, deyekum bedina demalka, deka alin leh techot ara leitrakkeva, venishmata itparsha
402: Utenan, leolam yargiz adam yetzer tov al yetzer hara, veyishtaddel avatreh. i azil minneh, yaot. vei lav, yishtaddal beorayyta. deha let lach milla letavra yetzer hara ella orayyta. i azil, mutav. vei lav, yadkar leh yoma demota, begin letabbera leh.

Hacha it leistakkala, deha da hu (161 2) yetzer hara, veda hu malach hammavet. vechi malach hammavet mitbar mikkamme yoma demota. veha ihu katola divni nasha have, veishtema dechedva hu dileh. uvegin kach aste lon livni nasha tadir, begin leamshacha lon leda.

Ella vadday ma deittemar, deyidkor leh bar nash hahu yoma demota. vadday hachi hu, begin demitbar libba devar nash. deha yetzer hara la sharya ella beatar deishtakkach chedva dechamra, vegassuta derucha. vechad ishtakkach rucha tevira, keden itperash minneh, vela sharya bahadeh. uvegin kach bae leadkara leh yoma demota, veyitbar gufeh, veihu azil leh.

Ta chaze, yetzer tov bae chedva deorayyta, veyetzer ra chedva dechamra, veniufin vegassuta derucha. uvegin kach bae bar nash leargaza (leh) tadir, mehahu yoma rabba, yoma dedina, yoma dechushebna. delet leh levar nash laagana aleh, ella ovadoy dechashran, deihu avid behay alma. begin deyaginu aleh behahi shata.

Ta chaze, vayyiru haanashim ki huveu bet yosef. uma kullehu havu gibbarin, kullehu takkifin, vechad ulema deayyte lon leveta deyosef, dachalu. kad yete kudesha berich hu lemitba leh ledina levar nash, al achat kamma vechamma.

Begin kach bae leh levar nash, leizdahara behay alma. leittakfa beh bekudesha berich hu, veyashve beh rochatzaneh. deaf al gav deihu chate, i yehdar minneh bityuveta shelemata, ha takkif ihu, veyittakkaf beh bekudesha berich hu, keillu la chata.

Deha shivtin, begin dechatu al genevat yosef, havu dachalin. deillemale la chatu, la havu dachalin kelal. begin dechovoy devar nash metabberin libbeh, velet leh chela kelal. may tama, deha hahu yetzer hattov itbar immeh, velet leh chela leittakkefa al hahu yetzer hara. veal da ketiv, (Devarim 20:8) mi haish hayyare verach hallevav, hayyare (dayraah da) mechovin devidoy, deinun tevira delibba devar nash.

Veta chaze, lechamma darin itpera kudesha berich hu, meinun chovin deshivtin, deha la itavid mikkammeh dekudesha berich hu kelum. veitpera middara ledara, vedina kayyma kammeh tadir, ad deitpera, veshare dina beatar deitzterich.

Menalan, mechizkiyyahu. chizkiyyahu chav hahu chova, degale setirin dekudesha berich hu, lishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, dela hava itzterich legallaa. vekudesha berich hu shaddar leh lishayahu, veamar leh, (Yeshayahu 39:6) hinne yamim baim venissa kol asher bevetecha vaasher atzru avotecha ad hayyom hazze vegomer.

Ta chaze, kamma garim hahu chova, begin degalle ma dehava satim. dechevan deitgele, ityeyhiv ducheta leatar ochora dela itzterich, leshalletaa aleh. begin kach lav beracha sharya, ella beatar satim. veukemuha, ma deihu (hava) satim, beracha (dehava) sharya aloy, kevan deitgele ityeyhiv ducheta, leatar ochora leshaltaa aloy.

Ketiv, (Eicha 1:8) kol mechabbedeha hizziluha ki rau ervatah, veukemuha. aval kol mechabbedeha hizziluha, da hu malchut bavel, deha mittamman ishtaddar doron liyrushelem. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 39:1) baet hahi shalach merodach baladan ben baladan melech bavel sefarim umincha el chizkiyyahu.

Uma ketiv behu, shelam lechizkiyahu melech yehuda, ushelam lelaha rabba ushelam liyrushelem. kevan denafak pitkeh minneh, ahadar lelibbeh veamar, la yaot avdit leakdama shelama deavda, lishlama demareh. kam mikkuresye ufasa 3 pesian veahadar pitkeh, vechatav ochoranin techotayyhu, vechatav hachi. shelam lelaha rabba, shelam liyrushala 40, ushelam lechizkiyya, veda hu mechabbedeha.
403: Ulevatar hizziluha, may tama hizziluha. begin ki rau ervata, deachze lon chizkiyya. deilmale kach, lo hizziluha levatar. miggo dehava zakkaa chizkiyyahu yattir, itakkav milla milleayytaa, vela ata beyomoy. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 39:8) ki yihye shalom veemet beyamay. ulevatar pakkid hahu chova livnoy abbatreh.

Kegavvna da, hahu chova deshivtin, kaim ad levatar. begin dedina dilela, la yachil leshalletaa alayyhu, ad deishtakkach shata leitpara, veitpera minnayyhu. ubbegin kach kol man deit chovin bidoy, dachil tadir. kema deat amer, (Devarim 28:66) ufachadta layla veyomam vegomer. veal da vayyiru haanashim ki huveu vegomer:

Vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv ben immo vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Mishlei 13:12) tochelet memushacha machala lev veetz chayyim taava vaa. da hu ditnan, delet leh levar nash leistakkala bevauteh legabbe kudesha berich hu, i ate, i la ate. may tama, begin dei ihu istakkel beh, kamma marehon dedina, atu leistakkala beh beovadoy.
Veraza ihu, deha hahu istakkeluta, deihu mistakkel behahu bauta, garim leh lemachalat lev. may machala lev, da ihu man dekaim tadir aleh devar nash, leastaa leela vetatta.

Veetz chayyim taava vaa. taninan, man devae dekudesha berich hu yekabbel tzeloteh, yishtaddal beorayyta, deihi etz chayyim. ucheden taava vaa. man taava, da hu darga dechol tzelotin dealma bideh, veail lon kamme malka illaa. ketiv hacha vaa, uchetiv hatam, (Ester 2:14) baerev hi vaa. veda hu taava vaa, baa kamme malka illaa, leashlama reuta dehahu bar nash.

Davar acher, tochelet memushacha machala lev, da hu atar, deityeyhiv hahi milla, beatar ochora dela itzterich. veitmashshecha ad deityeyhiv miyyada leyada, ulezimnin dela yiyite. may tama, begin deitpashsheta veitmashshecha bechol inun memannan, lenachata leh lealma.

Veetz chayyim taava vaa, da hu tochelet, dela itmashshecha, begin inun memannan retichin, ella dekudesha berich hu yahiv (lon) leh lealtar. begin dechad itmashshecha ben inun memannan retichin, kamma inun marehon dedina deityeyhiv lon reshuta. leayyna uleistakkela bedineh, ad la yinnatnun leh. uma denafik mibbe malka veityeyhiv leh levar nash, ben dezache, ben dela zache, ityeyhiv miyyad. veda hu etz chayim taava vaa.

Davar acher, tochelet memushacha, da yaakov. deitmashshecha leh tochalta deyosef ad zeman arich. veetz chayyim taava vaa, da hu binyamin. deha mizzimna detava leh yosef, ad hahu zimna deata legabbeh, la hava ella zimna zeer. dela itmashshecha hahu zimna. hada hu dichtiv, vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv ben immo. may ben immo. dediukeneh deimmeh hava beh, vehava dame diukeneh lediukena derachel. vegin kach ketiv, vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv ben immo.

Ribbi yose amar, veha ketiv bekadmita, vayyar yosef ittam et binyamin. vehasheta ketiv, vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv. may reiya hacha. ella chama berucha dekudesha levinyamin, dechulakeh hava immehon beara. uvechulakeh devinyamin vihuda tishre shechinta. deha chama leh lihuda uvinyamin, divchulekehon hava makdesha. veda hu vayyar yosef ittam et binyamin. leh chama immehon, veyosef dehava achuha la chama immehon behahu chulaka.
Uf hacha, vayyissa enav vayyar et binyamin achiv ben immo. ma ketiv batreh. vaymaher yosef ki nichmeru rachamav el achiv vayvakkesh livkot vayyavo hachadra vayyevchi shamma.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 22:1) massa ge chizzayon ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot. ta chaze, ha ukemuha bezimna deitchariv be makdesha, vehayu mokdin leh benura, seliku kol inun kahane
404: Al kotlehon (nusach acher gageyhevan) demakdesha, vechol maftechin bidayyhu, veamru. ad hacha havena gizbarin dilach, mikkan vaelach tol dilach.

Aval ta chaze, ge chizzayon, da shechinta dehavat bemakdesha. vechol bene alma, minah havu yankin yeniku dinvua. deaf al gav dechol neviin, ka havu mitnabbein meatar ochora, miggavvav havu yankin nevuathon. veal da itkere ihi ge chizzayon. chizzayon, ha ukemuha, deihu chezu dechol gevavnin illain.

Ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot, deha kad itcharav makdesha, shechinta atat, uselikat bechol inun atrin, dehava medorah behu bekadmita. vahavat bachat al bet medorah, veal yisrael deazlu begaluta, veal kol inun tzaddike vachaside dehavu tamman veitavidu. umenalan, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) ko amar Adonai kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al baneha, veha ittemar. ucheden kudesha berich hu shail lah lishchinta, veamar lah. ma lach efo ki alit kullach laggaggot.
Mahu kullach, deha ki alit sagya, mahu kullach. leachlala bahadah kol chelin vechol retichin ochoranin, dechullehu bechu immah al churban be makdesha.

Uvegin kach, ma lach efo. amra kammeh, vechi banay begaluta, umakdesha ittokda, veana ma li hacha. shariat veamrat, (Yeshayahu 22:2) teshuot melea ir homiyya kirya alliza chalalayich lo challe cherev velo mete milchama al ken amarti sheu minni amarer babbechi vegomer. veha okimna, dekudesha berich hu amar lah, (Yirmeyahu 31:16) ko amar Adonai mini kolech mibbechi vegomer.

Veta chaze, miyyoma deitchariv be makdesha, la hava yoma dela ishtakkach beh levavtin. begin dechad be makdesha hava kayyaym, havu yisrael palchin pulechanin vekarvin illavvavn vekarbanin, ushechinta sharya beve makdesha alayyhu, keimma dirvia al benayay. vehavu kol anpin nehirin, ad deishtakkachu birchan leela vetatta. vela hava yoma, dela ishtakkach beh birchan vechedvavn. vehavu yisrael sharan lerachatzan beara, vechol alma hava ittezan beginayyhu.
Hasheta deitchariv be makdesha, ushechinta immehon begaluta, let lach yoma dela ishtakkach beh levavtin, vealma itlatya. vechedvavn la ishtakkachu leela vetatta.

Vezammin kudesha berich hu, leakama lah lichneset yisrael meafra, kema deittemar. ulemechede alma becholla. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 56:7) vahaviotim el har kadshi vesimmachtim bevet tefillati vegomer. uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 31:9) bivchi yavou uvetachanunim ovilem. kema divkadmmita, dichtiv, (Eicha 1:2) bacho tivke ballayla vedimatah al lechoyah. hachi name levatar, bivchi yithadderun. dichtiv, bivchi yavou vegomer:

Habboker or vehaanashim shullechu hemma vachamorehem, ribbi elazar amar, hacha it leistakkala, i inun havu azle veishtaddaru, ma lan lemichtav beorayyta, hemma vachamorehem. ella begin dichtiv velakachat otanu laavadim veet chamorenu, begin kach vehaanashim shullechu hemma vachamorehem. begin dela yishtaarun inun vachamorehon, kidkaamru.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 22:3) vayyashkem avraham babboker vayyachavosh et chamoro vegomer, hahu boker deavraham hava nahir, lekayyma alayyhu bizchuteh. keden zechuta deavraham kayyma alayyhu, veazlu bishlam, veishtezivu min dina. begin dehahi shata, kayyma alayyhu dina, leitpara minnayyhu. bar dizchuta dehahu boker deavraham, agin alayyhu. veishtallachu min dina, dela shallit alayyhu behahu zimna.

Ribbi yehuda patach, (Shmuel 2 23:4) ucheor boker yizrach shemesh. da hu nehora, dehahu boker deavraham. yizrach shemesh, da hu shimsha deyaakov. dichtiv, (Bereshit lak) vayyizrach lo hashshemesh. boker lo avot, dehahu boker la ihu avot kol kach, ella minnoga mimmatar. noga mimmatar, ihu mittera deate missitra deyitzchak, dehahu mitra appik deshe mearetz.
Davar acher, ucheor boker, behahu nehiru devoker deavraham.
405: Yizrach shemesh, da hu yaakov. dinhiru dileh, kinhiru dehahu boker. boker lo avot, begin dehahu boker, lav ihu chashuch, ella nahir. deha beshata deate boker, la shalta dina kelal. ella kolla nahir, besitra deavraham. minnoga mimmatar, da hu sitra deyosef hatztzaddik, deihu amtir al ara, leafaka disa, vechol tivu dealma.

Amar ribbi shimon, ta chaze, beshata delelya al, ufaris gadfoy al alma, kamma gardine tehirin, zeminin lenafka, uleshalletaa bealma. vechamma marehon dedinin, mitarin bechamma sitrin liznayyhu, veshalte al alma. kevan deate tzafra venahir, kullehu mistalleke, vela shalte, vechol chad vechad al leducheteh, vetav leatreh.

Kema deat amer, habboker or, da boker deavraham. vehaanashim shullechu, illen marehon dedina, dehavu shaltin belelya. hemma vachamorehem (sefer acher hemma inun marehon dedina dekaamaran, vachemaverayham) inun gardine nimusin, deatyayn missitra dimsaava. delav inun kaddishin, vela shaltin, vela itchazun mechi ate tzafra. veinun missitra deinun chamari, gardini nimusin dekaamru.

Deha let lach dargin illain. dela itay (it) behu yemina usemala, rachame vedina. dargin al dargin kaddishin, missitra dikdushsha. umesaavin, missitra dimsaava. vechullehu dargin al dargin, illen al illen.

Uvechol atar devoker deavraham itar bealma, kullehu mitavre, vela shalte. begin delet lon (15 kiyyuma) lekayyma bistar yemina, ella bistar semala. vekudesha berich hu avad yemama velelya, leanhaga kol chad vechad lesitreh kedka chaze leh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, bealma den, uvealma deate.

Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha. ta chaze, zammin kudesha berich hu leanhara lon leyisrael, hahu shimsha, deganiz kudesha berich hu, miyyoma deitbere alma. (deganiz kudesha berich hu) mikkamme rashshie dealma. kema dichtiv, (Iyov 38:15) vayyimna mershaim oram.

Vehahu nehora ganiz leh kudesha berich hu. dechad nafak bekadmita, hava nahir misseyayfe alma, vead seyayfe alma. kevan deistakkal bedareh deenosh uvedareh demabbul. uvedareh dehaflaga, uvechol inun chayyayvaya. ganiz leh lehahu nehora.

Kevan deata yaakov, veitdabbak behahu memanna ravreva deesav, veakkish leh beyarcha dileh, vehava nache. keden ma ketiv, vayyizrach lo hashshemesh, man shemesh, hahu shimsha deganez. begin deit beh asuta, leittesaa leh mearkuvateh, ulevatar ittese behahu shimsha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 33:18) vayyavo yaakov shalem, shalem begufeh deittese.

Veal da, zammin kudesha berich hu legallaa hahu shimsha, uleanhara leh leyisrael. dichtiv, vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka, may shemesh tzedaka. da shimsha deyaakov, deittese beh. umarpe bichnafeha, dehahu shimsha, yittesun kullehu. begin deha bezimna dikumun yisrael meafra, kamma chigrin vechamma sumin yehon behon. ucheden kudesha berich hu yanhir lon hahu shimsha leittesaa bah. dichtiv umarpe bichnafeha.

Ucheden, yitnehir hahu shimsha, misseyyfe alma, ad seyayfe alma. uleyisrael yehe asvavta, veammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot beh yittokdun. aval leyisrael ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 58:8) az yibbaka kashshachar orecha vaaruchatcha mehera titzmach vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha kevod Adonai yaasfecha.

Ahadarna lemile kadmae: uleyosef yullad sheni vanim beterem tavo shenat haraav vegomer. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Micha Adonai:6) vehaya sheerit yaakov baggoyim bekerev ammim rabbim ketal meet Adonai kirvivim ale esev asher lo yek1ve leish velo yeyachel livne adam. ta chaze, bechol yoma veyoma, kad nehora salka. itar chad tzippora beilana deginta deeden, vekare telat zimnin. vesharvita yizdakkaf, vecharoza kare vechayil, lechon amrin, huremani devoryayre. man minnechon dechame vela chame. dekayyma bealma, vela yade al ma kayyme, la mashgichin bikara demarehon.
406: Orayyta kayyma kammayyhu, vela mishtaddele vah. tav lon dela yibbarun, al ma yekumun bela sachletanu. vavy lon kad yitarun yome dera alayyhu, veyitredun lehon mealma.
Man inun yomin dera, i salka datach deinun yome desivu, lav hachi. deha yome desivu, i zacha bivnin uveni venin, yome detav inun. man inun yomin dera,

Ella inun kema deittemar. dichtiv, (Kohelet 12:1) uzechor et borecha bime vechurotecha ad asher lo yavou yeme haraa, lav inun yomin desivu. ella raza demilla, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, bara leh beatvavn deorayyta. vechol at veat oolat kammeh, ad deitkayymu kullehu atvavn beat vet. vechol inun alfa betot deitgalgelu atvavn, kullehu kayyme (kullehu) lemivri alma.

Kevan deitgalgelu veitchabbaru teren atvavn illen 209 kechada, salka 419 vela ityayshvat, ad degaar bah kudesha berich hu. veamar lah, 419 419, al ma at salka vela ityayshvat beduchetich. amra kammeh. vechi avdat li lemehve at beresha detov, deha orayyta patach bi ki tov. hech ana mitchabbera leityayshva beat ra.
Amar lah, tuv leatrich, deha at tzarich lah. deha var nash deana bae lemivre bechon, tarvavyychu itkelil kechada, veyitbere. aval at limina, veihi lismala. ucheden tavu veityayshvu da beda kechada.

Behahi shata parish lon kudesha berich hu, uvara lon lechol chad vechad, yomin ushenin yedian. illen limina veillen lismala. illen deyamina, itkerun yeme hattov, veillen dismala itkerun yeme haraa. veal da amar shelomo, ad asher lo yavou yeme haraa. deillen mesacharin leh levar nash bechovoy deihu avid. kevan deitberun yomin detov, veyomin dera, keden tavu veityayshvu, leitkelala behu bevar nash.
Uvegine chach amar david, (Tehillim 49:6) lamma ira bime ra avon akevay yesubbeni. yeme ra vadday. veraza da, illen ikrun yeme raav, shenin deraav, veillen ikrun yeme sava, shene sava.

Veraza demilla, dela leafaka mabbua divrit kaddisha, beyome raav, bishnat haraav. uvegin kach yosef deihu raza divrit, satim mabbueh bishnat haraav. vela yahav leh ducheta leasgaa bealma. veda bae leh levar nash, dechad shalta shenat haraav, deyastim mabbua divrit kaddisha dileh. begin dela yahav leh ducheta leasgaa bealma.

Ribbi shimon amar, raza da ihu raza illaa. behahi shenat haraav, kevan deihi shalta, bae leastama mabbueh. begin dei la satim leh, garim leamshacha rucha lehahu valda mehahu sitra. veyahiv ducheta lehahu sitra lemifshe bealma, sitra dimsaava besitra dekudesha. vetu raza, dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:21) tachat shalosh ragza eretz vegomer.

Ubbegin kach yosef tzaddika, raza divrit, salik vesatim mabbueh, bishnat haraav. dela leitarva bahadah kelal, ulemehav lah ducheta. uman deaftach mabbueh behahu zimna, aleh ketiv, (Hoshea Adonai:7) baAdonai bagadu ki vanim zarim yaladu atta yochlem vegomer. deha illen ikrun banim zarim vadday. baAdonai bagadu vadday. ubbegin kach zakkaa chulakhon deyisrael kaddishin, dela itchallefu ducheta kaddisha, beducheta mesaava.

Veal da ketiv, uleyosef yullad sheni vanim beterem tavo shenat haraav. deha mehahu zimna deshalta shenat haraav, astim mabbueh vesalik mekoreh, dela lemehav benin lesitra mesaava, vela leachlafa ducheta dekudesha, beducheta dimsaava. uvae var nash lechakkaa lemareh dekudesha, kad yete veyishlot, kedichtiv, (Yeshayahu 8:17) vechikketi laAdonai hammastir panav mibbet yaakov vekivviti lo.

Zakkain inun tzaddikaya, deyadin orchoy dekudesha berich hu, venatre pikkude deorayyta lemehach behu. dichtiv, (Hoshea 14:10) ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam. uchetiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom. (davar acher 33 dichtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani 2. deha, kudesha berich hu baa lekaddesha lehu leyisrael becholla velo yehe lon besitra dimsaava kelum) (401 chaze kad sitra da shalta bealma lo itzterich leh levar nash leitchazaa beshuka kammeh begin deyachil lenazka veityeyhiv leh reshuta lechabbala. veta chaze beyaakov ma ketiv vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau, dela bae leitchazaa kammeh).
407: Uvegin da, kudesha berich hu azhar lehu leyisrael leitkaddasha. (kema deat amar) (davar acher dichtiv), vihyitem kedoshim ki kadosh ani. man ani. da kudesha berich hu, malchut shamayim kaddisha. malchuta achara deovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, ikre acher. dichtiv, (Shemot la) ki lo tishtachave leel acher ki Adonai kanna shemo.

Veta chaze, ani, shaltanu dealma den, vealma deate, vecholla beh talya. acher, sitra mesaava. acher, sitra ochora besitra mesaava, veshuletanu dileh behay alma, velet leh bealma deate kelum. uvegin da man deitdabbak behay ani, it leh chulaka bealma den uvealma deate.

Uman deitdabbak behay acher, itavid mehahu alma, velet leh chulaka bealma deate. veit leh chulaka behay alma, bimsaavu. begin dehahu malchu achara ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, kamma inun teresin gardinin memannan beh, leshalletaa behay alma.
Uvegine kach, elisha acher, denachat veitdabbak behay darga, itterid mehahu alma deate, vela ityeyhiv leh reshu lemehdar bityuveta, veitterid mehahu alma, veal da ikre acher.

Ubbegin kach bae var nash leitperasha mikkol sitrin, dela leistaava behahu sitra, lemizke behay alma uvealma deate. veal da, da beracha, veda kelala. da sava, veda raav. kolla behippucha da min da. veha okimna.
Uvegin kach, behahu zimna dishnat haraav, let leh levar nash leitchazaa beshuka, vela leiftecha mabbueh leolada, lemehav benin leel acher, veha ittemar.

Zakkaa ihu var nash deistammar lemehach beorach keshot, uleitdabbeka bemareh tadir. dichtiv, (Devarim 10:20) uvo tidbak. (uchetiv, et Adonai elohecha tira oto tabed uvo tadbek) uvishmo tishshavea, uvo tishshavea. la ketiv, ella uvishmo. may tishshavea, kema deokimna, lemeheve mitdebak beraza dimhemnuta.

Shiva dargin leela illain al kolla, raza dishlimu dimhemnuta. veraza deshiva dargin diltatta minnayyhu, deinun chibbura chad, vekishshura chad, illen beillen, lemeheve kullehu chad. uvegin kach ketiv, (Melachim 1 8:65) shivat yamim veshivat yamim 14 yom. vecholla chad, vekishshura chad, veal da ketiv uvishmo tishshavea, milleela umittatta.

Zakkaa ihu (nusach acher man dezache leitdabbeka beh bekudesha berich hu kedka yeot. zakkaa hu bealma din uvealma deate. dekudesha berich hu patach leh otzrin tavin kaddishin beshaata deitzterich lekabbela tzelota kema deat amar). (nusach acher uman dameyychad illen beillen, aleh ketiv), (Devarim 28:12) yiftach Adonai lecha et otzaro hattov et hashshamayim, illen otzarin dilela vetatta. shivat yamim veshivat yamim kullehu chad. dichtiv, et otzaro hattov et hashshamayim. otzaro chad, veihu et hashshamayim. (Zecharya 4:2) shiva veshiva mutzakot, veinun chad.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose havu azle vearcha, addehachi chamu chad var nash dehava ate, mitattef beittufa demitzva uchele zayynin keturin techotoy. amar ribbi chiyyay, var nash den, chad mitterin it beh. o zakkaa shelim ihu, o lerammaa (et) bene alma ihu.

Amar leh ribbi yose, ha chaside elyonin amru, heve dan lechol var nash lizchu. ha taninan, bar nash denafik learcha, yitkavven litlat millin. ledoron, likrava, litzlota. minnalan miyyaakov, deha litlat illen itkavvevn, vezariz garmeh ledoron, likrava, litzlota. vehay var nash, azil bearcha ihu. ha beh ittufa demitzva, litzlota. veha beh kele zayynin, likrava. kevan ditren illen it beh, telitay la lemirdaf avatrah.
Kad kariv legabbayyhu, yahavu leh shelam vela ativ lon. amar ribbi chiyyay, ha chad meinun
408: Teren, deitchazzeyayn lemehve beh let beh, deha la atkin garmeh ledoron, uvedoron shelama kalil beh. amar ribbi yose, dilma ihu mishtaddel bitzloteh, o marchish talmudeh begin dela yeakar leh.

Azle kechada, vela mallil hahu var nash bahadayyhu. levatar ishtemitu ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose veishtaddalu beorayyta. kevan dechama hahu var nash dehavu mishtaddele beorayyta, kariv legabbayyhu veyahiv lon shelam.

Amar lon, rabbotay, bemma chashadtun li, kad yahavittu li shelam, vela ativna lechu. amar leh ribbi yose, dilma tzelota havet amar, o marchish betalmudach. amar lon, kudesha berich hu yadin lechu lechaf zechu.

Aval ema lechu. yoma chad havena azil bearcha, ashkachna chad var nash, veakdimna leh shelam. vehahu gavra hava listim, vekam alay, vetzier li. veilmale deittakkafna beh itztaarna. mehahu yoma nadarna, dela leakdama shelam, bar levar nash zakkaa. ella i yedana beh bekadmita, begin deyachil letzaara li, veyitattakkaf bi bechela. begin deasir leakdama shelam levar nash chayyayva. dichtiv, (yeshaya mat) en shalom amar Adonai larshaim.

Vehahi shata dechamena lechu, veyahavittu li shelam vela ativna lechu. chashidna lechu. begin dela chamena bechu mitzva deitchaze levar. vahavena kemo chen mehaddar talmuday. aval hasheta dechamena vecho deattun zakkain, ha archa mittakkena kodamay.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 73:1) mizmor leasaf ach tov leyisrael elohim levare levav. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu avad yemina veavad semala, leanhaga alma. chad ikre tov vechad ikre ra. uvitren illen itkelil bar nash, veitkeriv becholla.

Vehahu ra deihu semala, itkelilu beh ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, veityehiv besitra dilhon. begin deinun arle libba, vearle bisra, uleistoova beh. aval beyisrael ma ketiv, ach tov leyisrael (ketiv).

Vei tema lechullehu, lav. ella leinun dela istaave bahade hahu ra. dichtiv, levare levav. begin deda tov veda ra. tov leyisrael bilchodayyhu, vera leammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. ach tov leyisrael, begin leidbaka beh. uvehay itdabbaku yisrael, beraza illaa, beraza dimhemnuta, lemeheve kolla chad. amar ribbi yose, zakkain anan, dela shabbashna bach. veha kudesha berich hu shadderach legabban.

Amar ribbi yose, begin detov hu leyisrael, yisrael it lon chulaka bealma den uvealma deate. lemechome ena beena chezu yekara. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 52:8) ki ayin beayin yiru beshuv Adonai tziyyon. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen: (ad kan parashat mikketz)
409: Bae lemivre, zammin hu leargaza kammach. ilmale la taarich rugeza, tav leh dela yitbere. amar lah kudesha berich hu, vechi lemaggana itkerena erech appayim.
Ella, kolla beorayyta itbere, vecholla beorayyta ishtachlal. begin dead la bara kudesha berich hu alma, atyayn kol atvavn kammeh, vealu kol chad vechad lemafrea.

Oolat 416. amra kammeh, reutach lemivre bi alma, amar la lav, devach zeminin kamma tzaddikaya lememat, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 9:4) vehitveta tav al mitzchot haanashim vegomer. vetaninan, dichtiv umimmikdashi tachellu. al tikre mimmikdashi, ella mimkuddashay. uvegin kach alma la yitbere bach.

Alu telat atvavn, shin, kuf, resh, kol chad vechad bilchodoy. amar lehu kudesha berich hu, lav attun keday lemivre bechu alma, deha attun atvavn deitkere bechu sheker, vesheker lav ihu keday lemekam kammay, veha ukemuha.
Vealu p 104, vechen kullehu, ad dematu atvavn leat 100. kevan denachat kf meal kitra, izdazau illae vetattae kulei, ad deitkayyem kela beat bet, deihu siman beracha, uveh ishtachlal alma veitbere.

Vei tema, delf ihu resha dechol (inun) atvavn, (lav) yaot ihu. ella begin deitkere beh arur (uvegin deitkere bah arur). uvegin da la itbere beh alma, af al gav delf ihu at deraza illaa. begin dela lemehav ducheta lesitra ochora deikre arur, la itbere beh alma. veishtachlal bevet alma, uveh itbere.
Ta chaze, ki atta avinu, begin dehay alma, behay darga ishtachlal veitbere. uvar nash beh itbere, venafak lealma.

Ki avraham lo yedaanu, deha af al gav deveh kiyyuma dealma. la ishtaddal alan, kema deishtaddal al yishmael. deamar, (Bereshit 17:18) lu yishmael yichye lefanecha. veyisrael lo yakkirennu, begin dechol birchan deitzterich levarcha livnoy, shavak lehay darga levarcha kullehu.

Atta Adonai avinu, deha ant kayymat alan tadir levarcha, uleashgacha alan, keabba deashgach al benin bechol ma deitzterich lon. goalenu meolam shemecha, deha ant hu goel, dehachi itkere hammalach haggoel. veda goalenu meolam shemecha, shemecha vadday. taninan, en mafsikin ben geulla litfilla, kema dela mafsikin ben tefilla shel yad litfilla shel rosh. devae lemechoze decholla chad, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havu yatve lelya chad velaan beorayyta. amar ribbi yitzchak leribbi yehuda, ha taninan dechad bara kudesha berich hu alma, avad alma tattaa kegavvna dealma illaa. vecholla da lokovel da. (davar acher tziyyen ze lemeheve da lekabbel da) veihu yekareh leela vetatta.

Amar ribbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. uvara adam al kolla, hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya 40) anochi asiti eretz veadam aleha barati. anochi asiti eretz vadday. may tama asiti eretz, begin deadam aleha barati, deihu kiuma dealma, lemeheve kolla bishlimu chad.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 42:5) ko amar hael Adonai bore hashshamayim venotehem roka haaretz vetzeetzaeha noten neshama laam aleha veruach laholchim bah. hay kera ukemuha, aval, ko amar hael Adonai bore hashshamayim venotehem, da kudesha berich hu leela leela. deihu bore hashshamayim, veatkin leh tadir bechol zimna. roka haaretz vetzeetzaeha, da ara kaddisha, tzerora dechayye. noten neshama laam aleha. (haaretz) da hi deyahava neshama vegomer.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kolla ihu leela, deha mittamman nafka nishmata dechayye, lehay eretz. vehay eretz, nakta nishmata lemehav lecholla. begin dehahu nahar denagid venafik, ihu yahiv veayil nishmatin lehay eretz, veihu nakta lon veyahava lecholla.
Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu leh leadam, achnish afreh mearba sitrin dealma. veavad garmeh beatar demakdesha letatta, veamshich aleh nishmata dechayye mibbe makdesha leela.
Venishmata ihi kelila bitlat dargin, veal da
410: Telat shemahan inun lenishmata, kegavvna deraza illaa. nefesh, ruach, neshama. nefesh, ha ukemuha deihi tattaa mikkolla. ruach, ihu kiyyuma deshalta al nefesh, veihu darga illaa alah, lekayyma alah becholla kedka chaze. neshama, ihi kiyyuma illaa al kolla, veshalta al kolla, darga kaddisha illaa al kullehu.

Veillen telat dargin, kelilan behu bivne nasha, leinun dezachan lefulechana demarehon. deha bekadmita it beh nefesh, veihu tikkuna kaddisha leittakkana bah bar nash. kevan deate bar nash leitdakkaa behay darga, ittakkan leitattera beruach. deihu darga kaddisha desharya al nefesh leitattera beh bar nash, hahu dezache.

Kevan deistallak behu, benefesh veruach, veal veittakkan befulechana demareh kedka yeut. keden sharya aleh neshama. darga illaa kaddisha, deshalta al kolla. begin leitattera bedarga illaa kaddisha. ucheden ihu shelima decholla, shelim bechol sitrin, lemizke bealma deate. veihu rechima dekudesha berich hu, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 8:21) lehanechil ohavay yesh. man inun ohavay, illen inun denishmata kaddisha behu.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi ha ketiv, (Bereshit 7:22) kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav vegomer. amar leh, hachi hu vadday. deha la ishtaar behu. mikkol inun dehavu behu nishmata kaddisha. kegon chanoch, yered vechullehu tzaddikayya, begin laagana al ara, dela yishtetze beginayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav mikkol asher becharava metu. kevar metu veistallaku mealma, vela ishtaar minnehon man deyagin al alma behahu zimna.

Ta chaze, kolla inun dargin, illen al illen. nefesh, ruach, neshama. darga al darga. nefesh bekadmita, veihi darga tattaa kidkaamaran. ruach levatar, desharya al nefesh vekayyma alah. neshama, darga desalka al kolla, veukemuha.

Nefesh, da nefesh david, veihi dekayyma lekabbela nefesh mehahu nahar denagid venafik. ruach, da ruach dekayyma aleh denafsha, velet kiyyuma lenefesh ella beruach. veda ihu ruach desharya ben eshsha umayya, umehacha ittezan hay nefesh.

Ruach, kayyma bekiyyuma dedarga ochara illaa deikre neshama, deha mittamman nafke nefesh veruach. mittamman ittezan ruach. vechad natil ruach, keden natla nefesh, vecholla chad. veitkerivu da beda. nefesh itkeriv beruach, veruach itkeriv binshama, vecholla chad.
Ta chaze, vayyiggash elav, tikruveta dealma bealma, leitachada da beda lemehve kolla chad. begin diyhuda ihu melech veyosef melech. itkerivu da beda, veitachidu da beda.

Ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 48:5) ki hinne hamelachim noadu, da yehuda veyosef. begin detarvavyyhu melachim, veitkerivu da beda leitvavkcha tarvavyyhu kachada. begin diyhuda itarev beh bevinyamin, vehava arev legabbeh deavoy beh, behay alma uvealma deate. veal da itkeriv kammeh deyosef, leitvavkcha immeh al iska devinyamin, dela lemehve benidduy. behay alma uvealma deate. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 43:9) anochi eervennu miyyadi tevakkeshennu im lo haviotiv elecha vehitztzagtiv lefanycha vechatati leavi kol hayyamim. behay alma uvealma deate.

Veal da, ki hinne hammelachim noadu avru yachdav, itregizu kechada, veitregizu da beda begineh devinyamin. ma ketiv, hemma rau ken tamahu nivhalu nechpazu reada achazatam sham, lechol inun dehavu tamman. (lechullehu shear shivtin dahavo tamman).

Chil kayyoleda, begin dehavu dachalin, lekatla uleitketala, vecholla begineh devinyamin. (davar acher tziyyen ze ma ketiv ken tamhu nivhalu nachepazev vecholla begineh) deha yosef izdabban begineh dihuda, veitavid meavoy. vehasheta itarav beh bevinyamin, vedachil dela yitavid. uvegin kach vayyiggash elav yehuda.
Davar acher, ki hinne hammelachim noadu, da yehuda veyosef,
411: Deizdammenu leitvakkecha da im da, leitvakkecha tarvavyyhu kechada. begin dihuda hava melech, veyosef hava melech, vetarvavyyhu atu kechada leitvakkecha da im da. da al binyamin, veda al binyamin.

Ki hinne hammelachim, amar ribbi yehuda, raza dimhemnuta hacha, deha kad reuta ishtakkach, vekishshura itattar kechada, keden teren almin mitkashsheran kechada veizdammenan kechada. da leaftacha otzara, veda lelakketa ulemichnash begavveh. ucheden ki hinne hammelachim noadu, teren almin kaddishin, alma illaa vealma tattaa.

Avru yachdav, raza demilla, dechad mitchabberan kechada, keden avru yachdav. begin dechol chiyyuvin dealma la itavran leitkafya, ad demitchabberan kechada. kedichtiv, (Micha 7:18) veover al pesha. veal da avru yachdav. avru, inun chovin itkapparu. begin deha cheden kol anpin nehirin, vechol chovin itavaru.

Ribbi chiyyay amar, raza da vetikkuna dekarbana ihu. deha kad karbana itkeriv vecholla mistappekin, vechol chad vechad kedka chaze leh, keden itkashshar kolla kechada. vechol anpin nehirin, vekishshura chad ishtakkach. ucheden hammelachim noadu veizdammenu kechada, lechappara al chovin, leaavara alayyhu. ucheden hammelachim noadu, veitkashsheran kechada. avru yachdav, leanhara kol anpin, ulemeheve kolla reuta chada.

Hemma rau ken tamahu, salka datach deinun melachim. ella illen marehon dedinin, dechedva dilhon lemebad hahu dina deitpakkedu aleh. ucheden, kad melachim izdammenu tarvavyyhu biruta chada, keden hema rau hahu reuta ditren almin. ken tamahu nivhalu nechpazu, begin dechullehu mare dedina itkafyayn umitavran mealma, vela yachle leshalletaa. ucheden mitavrin kiyyumehon, meavrin shaltanhon.

Ribbi elazar amar, vayyigash elav yehuda. may tama yehuda, begin dehachi itzterich, deihu arav. kema deat amer, ki avdecha arav et hannaar. veraza demilla, yehuda veyosef hachi itzterichu leitkarva kechada. begin deyosef ihu tzaddik, yehuda ihu melech. veal da vayyiggash elav yehuda. begin dekureva dilhon deitkerivu kechada, garam kamma tavin lealma. garam shelama lechullehu shivtin. garam shelama benayyhu. garam leyaakov deitkeyyaym rucha dileh. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 45:27) vattechi ruach yaakov avihem. veal da kerivu deda im da itzterich, bechullehu sitrin leela vetatta.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 48:3) yefe nof mesos kol haaretz har tziyyon yarkete tzafon kiryat melech rav. hay kera raza dimhemnuta ihu. yefe nof, da ihu yosef hatztzaddik, dichtiv beh, vayhi yosef yefe toar vife mare. mesos kol haaretz, ihu chedva vechedu leela vetatta. har tziyyon yarkete tzafon, begin divchulakeh kaim mashkena deshilo, har tziyyon da yerushala 40. yarkete tzafon, hachi hu vadday leela vetatta.

Kiryat melech rav, atar ihu metakkena, lokovel melech rav, da malka illaa decholla, kodesh hakkodashim. deha mittamman atya kol nehiru vechol birchan vechol chedu decholla. deha mittamman naharin kol anpin, uve makdesha itbarcha mittamman. vechad ihi mitbarcha, mittamman nafke birchan lechol alma, deha kol alma mittamman itbarcha.

Ribbi yehuda veribbi yose iaru bichfar chanan. ad dehavu yatve be ushepizayyhu, ata chad bar nash vechad matula dechamra kameh veal beveta. addehachi, amar ribbi yehuda leribbi yose, ha taninan, dedavid malka hava mitnamnem kesus, veshenteh zeer, hech hava kam befalgut lelya. hay shiura zeer ihu vela hava itar afillu bitlatut lelya.

Amar leh, beshata deal lelya, hava yativ im kol ravreve veteh vedain dina, veasik bemille deorayyta. ulevatar hava naim shenteh ad palgut lelya, vekam befalgut lelya veitar, veishtedal befulechana demareh, beshirin vetushebchan.
412: Hahu bar nash, vechi hay milla dekaamrittu, hachi hu. raza demilla hacha, deha david malka chay vekayyaym lealam ulealme almin. vedavid malka hava natir kol yomoy dela yitam taam mita. begin deshenta chad mishshittin bemita ihu. vedavid begin ducheteh deihu chay, la hava naim ella shittin nishme. dead shittin nishme chaser chad, ihu chay. mittamman ulehala, taim bar nash tama demota, veshallit beh sitra deruach mesaava.

Veda hava natir david malka, dela yitam tama demota, veshallit (sefer acher dela yshelayt) beh sitra derucha ochora, begin deshittin nishme chaser chad, ihu raza dechayyim dilela. ad shittin nishme, deinun shittin (davar acher 33 chaser chad nishme) nishme illain, veilen raza dilhon, detalyayn behon chayye. umikkan uletatta, raza demota hu.

Veal da, david malka hava meshaer shiura delelya, begin deyitkayyem bachayyim, dela yishlot beh tama demota. vechad itpelig lelya, hava david mitkayyem beatreh. begin dechad itar palgu lelya vechitra kaddisha itar, baa dela leashkacha leh ledavid mitkashshar beatar ochora, beatar demota.

Begin dechad itpelig lelya ukedushsha illaa itar, uvar nash denaim bearseh vela itar leashgacha bikara demareh. ha ihu itkashshar beraza demota umitdabbak beatar ochora, veal da david malka hava kaim leashgacha bikara demareh tadir. chay legabbe chay, vela naim beshenta letaama tama demota. uvegin kach, hava mitnamnem kesus shittin nishme, vela bishlimu.

Atu ribbi yehuda veribbi yose uneshakuha, amru leh, ma shemach. amar lehon, chizkiyya. amru leh, yityayshsher chelach veyittakkaf orayytach. yetivu. amar ribbi yehuda, hoil vesharit, ema lan mehanne razin illain dekaamart.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 3:19) Adonai bechachma yasad eretz konen shamayim bitvuna. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, chama dela yachil leitkayyma, ad devara orayyta. begin deminnah nafkin kol nimmusin illain vetattain, uvah kayyme illae vetattae. hada hu dichtiv, Adonai bechachma yasad aretz konin shamayim bitvuna. deha bechachma kayymin kol kiyyumin dealma, vechullehu nafke miggavvah.

Davar acher Adonai bechachma yasad eretz, alma illaa la itbere ella miggo chachma. vealma tattaa la itbere ella miggo chachma tattaa. vechullehu nafkan miggo chachma illaa umiggo chachma tattaa. konen shamayim bitvuna. konen, may konen. ella, konen kol yoma veyoma vela pasik, vela ittakkan bezimna chada, ella bechol yoma veyoma atkin leh.

Vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (Iyov 15:15) veshamayim lo zakku veenav. vechi salka datach, digriuta ihu mishshamayim, ella chashivu mishshamayim ihu, begin chavivu ureu sagya, dekudesha berich hu rae behu, vachavivutayhu legabbeh. deha af al gav deihu matkin lon kol yoma veyoma, la dame beenoy deinun mittaknan kedka yeut. begin dirchimuta dilhon legabbeh, ureuteh leanhara lon tadir bela pesiku. deha alma deate appik nehorin zehirin kol yoma veyoma tadir bela pesiku, begin leanhara lon tadir. veal da lo zakku beenav. lo zakku bilchodoy la ketiv, ella lo zakku veenav. uvegin kach, konen shamayim bitvuna.
Man shamayim. da hu raza deavahan, veraza deavahan da hu yaakov deihu kelala dilhon. begin deyaakov tushebachta deavahan ihu, veihu kayyma leanhara al alma.

Uvegin deihu istallak go alma deate, nafak minneh anafa chada shappira bechezu, vechol nehorin mineh nafkin. vechol sava umeshach revu leanhara leara, uman ihu. da yosef hatztzaddik, deihu yahiv sava lechol alma, vealma minneh ittezan. uvegin kach, kudesha berich hu kol ma deavad bealma, kolla ihu beraza illaa, vecholla kedka chaze.
Adhachi ata ribbi elazar, kevan dechama lon amar, vadday shechinta hacha. bemay askitu. amru leh
413: Kol ovada. amar, vadday shappir kaamar. aval inun shittin nishme, vadday shittin nishme inun dechayyin, ben leela ben letatta. mikkan ulehala, ikka shittin nishmin ochoranin, deinun kullehu missitra demota, vedarga demota alayyhu, veikrun duremita, vechullehu taama demota.

Uvegin kach david malka hava ihu mitdebak beinun shittin nishmin dechayyin, umittamman ulehala la naim kelal. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:4) im etten shenat leenay leafappay tenuma. veal da shappir kaamar, begin deyakum david chay, besitra dechay vela besitra demota. yatvu kullehu veishtaddelu beorayyta veitchabbaru kechada.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Tehillim 88:2) Adonai eloke yeshuati yom tzaakti vallayla negdecha. ta chaze, david malka hava kam befalgut lelya, veishtedal beorayyta beshirin vetushebchan, lechedva demalka umatronita. veda hava chedva dimhemnuta beara. begin dehay ihu shevacha dimhemnuta deitchaze beara.

Deha leela patche bechedva shirata kamma malachin illain, bechamma zinin deka meshabbechan belelya bechol sitrin. kehay gavvna letatta beara, man dimshabbach leh lekudesha berich hu beara belelya, rae beh (bae) kudesha berich hu. vechol inun malachin kaddishin deka meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu, kullehu tzayytin lehahu deka meshabbach leh belelya beara. dehay tushebachta ihu bishlimu, lesalka yekare dekudesha berich hu mittatta, ulezammera bechedva deyichuda.
Ta chaze, david malka katav, Adonai elohe yeshuati vegomer, Adonai elohe yeshuati, ematay ihu yeshuati. behahu yoma deakdemit tushebachta belelya legabbach, keden ihu yeshuati bimama.

Veta chaze, deha belelya, man dimshabbach lemareh betushebachta deorayyta, keden atkaf bitkifu biymama besitra dimina. deha chuta chad nafka missitra dimina, ucheden itmashshach aleh veittakkaf beh. veal da amar, Adonai elohe yeshuati yom tzaakti vegomer.

Uvegin kach amar, (Tehillim 115:17) lo hammetim yehallelu yah. lo hammetim, begin deitzterich leshabbecha chay lechay. umet lechay lav hachi, dichtiv lo hammetim yehallelu yah. vaanachnu nevarech yah, deha anan chayyin velet lan chulaka besitra demota kelal. chizkiyyahu amar, (Yeshayahu 38:19) chay chay hu yodecha kamoni, begin dechay itkerav lechay. david malka ihu chay, vekureva dileh lechay haolamim. uman deitkeriv legabbeh, ihu chay. dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom. uchetiv, (Shmuel 2 23:20) uvenayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay rav pealim mikkavtzeel.

Patach hahu yuday avatreh veamar, (Devarim 8:10) veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elokecha. vechi la mevarchinan leh lekudesha berich hu ad la nichul, veha it lan leakdume betzafra ulesiddure shevacha dileh (demareh) kedka yeut, ulevarcha bishmeh ad la yevarech leachara bealma. uchetiv (Vayikra 29) lo tochelu al haddam, asur leh lemechal ad la yevarech lemareh. vehasheta ketiv veachalta vesavata uverachta.

Ella, da birchata ditzlota deyichuda, veda birchata dimzona. leachazaa legabbe darga dimhemnuta, sava kedka yaot. ucheden bee levarcha leh kedka yeut, dehahu darga dimhemnuta yitravve vivarech, veyitmalle chedu mechayyin dilela kema deitzterich, begin lemehav lan mezone.

Deha kashin mezona devar nash kame kudesha berich hu, kikriat yam suf. may tama. begin dimzona dealma dilela hu, ditnan bane chayye umezone vechulei, uvegin kach kashyayn kammeh mezone dealma. deha bemazzala talya milta. deminneh nafke mezone vechayye uvane. uvegin kach kashin kammeh mezone dealma, deha lav birshuteh kayyma, ad deyitbarech ihu.
Kegavvna da ziyivgin dealma kashin kammeh, vecholla begin derakia vilon la meshammesh kelum. vechol shekken illen millin dekayymin leela beatar ochora, veal da itzterich leitbarcha.
Ta chaze, kol zivugin dealma kashin kammeh hay darga, begin dechad hay ziuuga kaddisha ishtakkach, kol
414: Nishmatin nafkin miggo hay mazzala leela, deihu hahu nahar denagid venafik. vechad tiuveta ishtakkach milra leela, keden parchin nishmatin, veityeyhivu kullehu kelilan dechar venukeva kechada behay darga. ulevatar ihu parish lon kol chad vechad leatreh kedka chaze leh. ulevatar kashin kamme hay darga lechabbera lon kekadmita, begin dela mitchabberan, bar keinun arche debar nash, vecholla leela talyayn.
Veal da kashin kammeh kikriat yam suf. deha keriat yamma leitpattecha beh shevilin, leela ihu. uchema demitpattechin shevilin veorchin beh, hachi itbakka veitpattach.
Uvegin kach kolla talya leela, uveinan levarcha leh, ulemehav leh tukefa mittatta, begin deyitbarcha milleela, veyittakkaf kedka chaze. veal da ketiv, uverachta et Adonai, et dayyka.

Ulegabbe hay atar, itzterich leachazaa kammeh sava unehiru deanpin. ulegabbe sitra ochora, bezimna deihi shalta bealma, bee leachazaa kammeh kafna. dehahu darga raav ihu, veitchaze leachazaa kammeh kafna vela sova, hoil vesava la shalta bealma. veal da, veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elokecha. amar ribbi elazar, hachi hu vadday, vehachi itzterich.

Amar ribbi yehuda, zakkain inun tzaddikayyay dekureva dilhon ihu shelama bealma. begin deyade leyachada yichuda, umekarve kureva leasgaa shelama bealma. deha yosef vihuda ad la itkerivu da im da, la hava shelama. kevan deitkerivu yosef vihuda kechada, keden asgiu shelama bealma. vechedu ittosaf leela vetatta, kema dekureva dihuda veyosef vechullehu shivtin ishtakkachu kechada beh beyosef. vehahu kureva asge shelama bealma, kema deokimna. dichtiv, vayyiggash elav yehuda:

Velo yachol yosef lehitappek lechol hannitztzavim alav vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 112:9) pizzar natan laevyonim tzidkato omedet laad karno tarum bechavod. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu bara alma, veashlit aleh laadam, dihe malka al kolla.

Vehay bar nash, mitparshan minneh bealma kamma zinin. minnehon tzaddikayya uminnehon rashshiaya. minnehon tippeshin uminnehon chakkimin. vechullehu itkayymu bealma, atirin umiskenin. vechullehu begin lemizke illen beillen, lemizke tzaddikaya im rashshiaya, lemizke chakkimin im tippeshin, lemizke atirin im miskenin. deha begin kach, zache bar nash lechayye alma, veitkashshar beilana dechayye. vela od, ella deha tzedaka deihu avid, kaim lealmin. dichtiv vetzidkato omedet laad.

Pizzar natan laevyonim. ribbi elazar amar, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, kaim leh al samcha chad, vetzaddik shemeh, vehay tzaddik ihu kiyyuma dealma, veda ihu deashke, vezan lecholla. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim.

Umishsham yippared, mahu yippared. ella, hahu mezona umashkaya dehahu nahar, natil ginta kolla, ulevatar itbaddar hahu mashkaya led sitrin dealma. vechamma inun dimtzappan leitshakyay uleittezna mittamman. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 145:15) eni chol elecha yesabberu veatta noten lahem et achlam beitto. uvegin kach pizzar natan laevyonim, da tzaddik. tzidkato omedet laad, da keneset yisrael. divgin kach, ihi kayyma beraza dishlam, bekiyyuma shelim. rasha yire vechaas, da malchut ovde kochavim umazzalot.

Ta chaze, malchut shamayim, ihi be makdesha. lekayyma kol miskene bego tzilla desheruta dishchinta. vetzaddik da ihu ikre gabbay tzedaka, lemechan ulemezan lecholla. dichtiv pizzar natan laevyonim. begin kach, gabbae tzedaka natle agra lokovel kullehu deyahave tzedaka.
Ta chaze, velo yachol yosef lehitappek lechol hannitztzavim, illen inun kol dekayyme leittezana uleitshakyay minneh. velo amad ish itto
415: Behitvadda yosef el echav. itto, da keneset yisrael. echav, illen shear retichin chayaylin, dichtiv behu (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay. davar acher, velo amad ish itto. bezimna dekudesha berich hu ate leizdavvevga bikkeneset yisrael. behitvadda yosef el echav, bezimna dekudesha berich hu hava mitchabber behu beyisrael, begin deinun natle bilchodayyhu, vela chibbura deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bahadayyhu. begin kach (Bamidbar 29:35) bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem. deha bezimna da, ihu kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, bechibbura chada im yisrael, dichtiv behu achay vereay kema deukemuha.

Ribbi yesa patach kera, bezimna dekudesha berich hu yokim lah lichneset yisrael meafra, veyibbae leinnakma nikmata meammemaya ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, keden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 63:3) umeamim en ish itti. uchetiv hacha, velo amad ish itto behitvadda yosef el echav. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 63:9) vaynattelem vaynasseem kol yeme olam.

Velo yachol yosef lehitappek, ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Tehillim 123:1) shir hammaalot elecha nasati et enay hayyoshvi bashshamayim, hay kera ukemuha veittemar. aval ta chaze, elecha nasati et enay, uchetiv, (Tehillim 121:1) essa enay el heharim. ella, da leela veda letatta. essa enay el heharim, da leela. begin leamshacha birchan meela letatta, meillen harim illain, leamshacha minnayyhu birchan lichneset yisrael deitbarcha minnayyhu. elecha nasati et enay, lemitzpe ulechakkaa leinnun birchan denachatu mittamman letatta.

Hayyoshvi bashshamayim, dechol tukefaha vechelaa vekiyyumaha, ihu bashshamayim. begin dechad yovela aftach mabbue dechol inun tarin, kullehu kayyme bashshamayim. vechevan deshamayim natil kol inun nehorin denafke miyyovela, keden ihu zan veashke lah lichneset yisrael al yeda detzaddik chad.

Vechevan deda itar legabbah, kamma inun dekayyman bechol sitrin leitshaka uleitbarcha mittamman. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:21) hakkefirim shoagim latteref ulevakkesh meel achlam. ucheden, ihi salka beraza derazin kedka chaze (davar acher 33 leh), umekabbela iddunin mivaalah kedka yeut, vechullehu dekayymin bechol sitrin amde bilchodayyhu. kema deat amer, velo amad ish itto. dichtiv, vayyikra hotziu kol ish mealay, ulevatar deihi mekabbela iddunin mibbaalah, kullehu itshakyayn levatar veittezanu. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday yishberu feraim tzemaam.

Ribbi yose patach kera beeliyyahu, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 17:20) vayyikra el Adonai vayyomar Adonai elohay hagam al haalmana asher ani mitgorer immah hareota lehamit et benah. ta chaze, tere havu dekaamrin millin lokovel kudesha berich hu, moshe veeliyyahu. moshe amar, (Shemot Adonai:22) lamma hareota laam hazze. veeliyyahu amar, hareota lehamit et benah, vetarvayyhu milla chada kaamru.

May tama. ella raza ihu. moshe amar, lamma hareota, may tama. ella, begin deityehiv reshu lesitra ochora leshalletaa alayyhu deyisrael, hareota, yehavt reshu lesitra ochora dera, lemishlat alayyhu. eliyyahu amar, hareota yehavt reshu lesitra dera, litol nishmata deda. veda hu hareota, vecholla raza chada.

Ta chaze, eliyyahu amar, hagam al haalmana asher ani mitgorer immah. begin dekudesha berich hu amar leh leeliyyahu, hinne tzivviti sham ishsha almana lechalkelecha. vechol man dezan umefarnes leman deitzterich leh, vechol shekken beyoma dechafna. ha itachid beilana dechayye, vegarim leh chayyim velivnoy, veha okimna. vehasheta eliyyahu amar, kol man dekiyyem nafsha bealma, zache leh chayyim vezache leitachada beilana dechayye. vehasheta shalta ilana demota sitra dera al haalmana deant pekadt lemezan li. begin kach hareota (lamma haraot).

Vei tema dera la itavid levar nash meim kudesha berich hu. ta chaze, bezimna devar nash azil limina, netiru dekudesha berich hu tadir legabbeh, vela yachil sitra ochora leshaltaa aleh. vehay ra itkafya kammeh, vela yachil leshalletaa. vechevan dintira dekudesha berich hu itavra minneh, begin
416: Deihu itdabbak bera, keden hahu ra, kevan dechame delav immeh netiru, keden shallit aleh, veate leshetzaa leh, ucheden ityehiv leh reshu, venatil nishmateh.

Moshe amar lamma hareota, deityehiv leh reshu lesitra dera, lemishlat alayyhu deyisrael, lemeheve beshibuda dileh. davar acher lamma hareota, dechama kamma minhon dehavu metin, veitmesaru besitra dera.

Ta chaze, beshata detov itar, deihu yemina, kol chedu, vechol tivu, vechol birchan mishtakkechan, vecholla bachashay ihu, kema deukemuha, deamre baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed bachashay, veraza da begin (sefer acher dehay ihu yichuda) deihu keden yichuda kedka chaze.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, vechi eliyyahu, kevan deihu gazar, vekudesha berich hu mekayyem. veihu gazir al shemaya, dela laachata mitra vetalla, hech dachil ihu meizevel, deshadderat leh. dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:2) ki chaet machar asim et nafshecha kenefesh achad mehem, umiyyad dachil vearak al nafsheh.

Amar leh ribbi yose, ha ukemuha, detzaddikaya la baan leatracha lemarehon, beatar denizka ishtakkechat (leh) leena. kegavvna dishmuel, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 16:2) ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani, amar leh, eglat bakar tikkach beyadecha. begin detzaddikayya la baan leatracha lemarehon beatar denizka ishtakkach. uf hachi eliyyahu, kevan dechama denizka ishtakkach, la bae leatracha lemareh.

Amar leh, ana milla shemana, deha beeliyyahu la ketiv beh vayyira vayyelech el nafsho, ella (Melachim 1 19:3) vayyar. reiya chama. uma chama, ella chama deha mikkamma shenin azal batreh malach hammavt, vela itmasar bideh. vehasheta vayyelech el nafsho, may vayyelech el nafsho, azal lekiyyuma denafsha, uman ihu ilana dechayye leitdabbeka tamman.

Ta chaze, kullehu ketiv et nafsho, vehacha ketiv el nafsho, veraza da shemana, deamar ribbi shimon, kol nishmatin dealma, kullehu nafke mehahu nahar denagid venafik, vechullehu nakit lon hahu tzerora dechayyay (dechayye), vechad nukeva itabberat min dechura, kullehu betiuveta ditren sitrin, betiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura. vechad tiuveta didchura nafka biruta, keden inun nishmatin bekiyyuma yattir, begin decholla betiuveta ureu deilana dechayyay. veeliyyahu, begin dehava mehahu reuta yattir mibbar nash ochora, itkeyyaym.

Uvegin kach el nafsho ketiv, vela ketiv et nafsho. deha et nafsho da hi nukeva. vei tema veel haishsha amar, kelala diddechar venukeva. kad hi bego dechura, keden veel haishsha amar. et haishsha, nukeva bilchudaha, vela diddechura. kegavvna da el nafsho, dachar bilchodoy, et nafsho nukeva bilchudaha vela kelilu diddechura. uvegin deihu missitra diddechura yattir mikkol bene alma, itkeyyaym bekiyyumeh yattir, vela mit kishar bene alma. begin decholla ihu meilana dechayye, vela miggo afra. uvegin da istallak leela, vela mit keorach kol bene alma. dichtiv, (Melachim 2 2:11) vayyaal eliyyahu bisara hashshamayim.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vehinne rechev esh vesuse esh vegomer, (Shemot 197 amud alef) deha keden itpashshat gufa min rucha, veistallak dela kishar orach bene alma. veishtaar malacha kaddisha, kishar kaddishe elyonin, veavid shelichuta vealma. veha ukemuha, denissin deavad kudesha berich hu bealma, al yedeh itavidan.

Veta chaze, ma ketiv, (Melachim 1 19:3) vayyishal et nafsho. bekadmita, vayyelech el nafsho, kema deittemar bekiyyuma. vehacha et nafsho lamut, ilana deveh sharya mota. vetamman itgeli aleh kudesha berich hu, kema dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:12) tze veamadta bahar. ma ketiv batreh, veachar haraash esh la vaesh Adonai veachar haesh kol demama dakka, da hu atar penimaa decholla, deminneh nafkin kol nehorin.

Ma ketiv, (Melachim 1 19:13) vayhi kishmoa eliyyahu vayyalet panav beaddarto vehinne elav kol vayyomer (tissa 190 amud alef) ma lecha fo eliyyahu vayyomer kanno kinneti, amar leh kudesha berich hu, ad matay atta mekanne li, terakat galla dela
417: Yachil leshalletaa bach mota lealma, vealma la yachil lemisbelach im banay (nasha). amar leh, ki azvu veritcha beni yisrael vegomer. amar leh, chayyecha, debchol atar devanay (nasha) yekayyeymu keyaym kaddisha, ant tehe zammin tamman. (davar acher veha ittemar begin kach metakkenin kurisaya leeliyyahu deihu zammin tamman)

Ta chaze, ma garam hahi milla deeliyyahu, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:18) vehisharti beyisrael shivat alafim kol habbirkayim asher lo karu labbaal vechol happe asher lo nashak lo. amar leh kudesha berich hu, mikkan ulehala, dela yachil alma lemisbelach im banay (nasha). veet elisha ben shafat meavel mechola timshach lenavi tachtecha. yehe nevia ochora legabbe banay (nasha), veat tistallak leatrach.

Veta chaze, kol hahu bar nash dimkanni leh lekudesha berich hu, la yachil malacha demota leshalletaa beh, kishar bene nasha. veyitkayyem beh shelam, veha ukemuha. kema deittemar befinchas, (Bamidbar 25:12) lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom:
Vayyippol al tzavvere binyamin achiv vayyevchi uvinyamin bacha al tzavvarav. ribbi yitzchak amar, ha ukemuha, devacha al mikdash rishon veal mikdash sheni.

Patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 4:4) kemigdal david tzavvarech banuy letalpiyyot elef hammagen taluy alav kol shilte haggibborim. kemigdal david, man migdal david. da migdal david vadday, devana leh david, vesalik leh go yerushalayim. ella kemigdal david, da yerushalem dilela, dichtiv beh, (Mishlei 18:10) migdal oz shem Adonai bo yarutz tzaddik venisgav. man nisgav, ella hahu migdal nisgav, begin deveh yarutz tzaddik.
Tzavvarecha, da bet makdesha diltatta, deihu kaim betikkuna deshappiru, kekadla legufa. ma tzavvar, ihu shappiru dechol gufa, hachi name be makdesha, ihu shappiru dechol alma.
Banuy letalpiyyot, tilla dechol bene alma havu mistakkelan beh, vehachi ukemuha, talpiyyot, tel dechol piyyot dealma meshabbechan umetzallan legabbeh.
Elef hammagen taluy alav, illen elef tikkunin, dimtakkenin beh kedka yeut. kol shilte haggibborim, dechullehu ka atyayn missitra dedina kashya.

Ma tzavvar, kol tikkunin deitteta beh talyayn. kach bemakdesha, kol tikkunin dealma beh talyayn vesharyayn. veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Eicha Adonai:Adonai) al tzavvarenu nirdafnu, al be makdesha, deihu tzavvar veshappiru dechol alma. nirdafnu, yaganu lemivne leh teren zimnin, velo hunach lanu. deha la shavkuha lan, veitcharav vela itbene levatar.

Ma tzavvar, kevan deishtetze, kol gufa ishtetze immeh. hachi name be makdesha, kevan deihu ishtetze veitchashshach, kol alma hachi name itchashshach, vela nahir shimsha, vela shemaya veara vechochvaya.

Begin kach bacha yosef al da. ulevatar devacha al da, bacha al shivtin deitgalu. kad itchariv be makdesha, kullehu shivtin itgalu miyyad, veitbadderu bene ammaya. hada hu dichtiv vaynashshek lechol echav vayyevchi alehem, alehem vadday.

Al kullam bacha, al be makdesha deitchariv teren zimnin, veal achoy aseret hashshevatim, deitgalu begaluta veitbadderun bene ammaya. veachare chen dibberu echav itto, vela ketiv vayyivku, deha ihu bacha, denitznetza beh rucha kaddisha, veinun la bachu, dela shara alayyhu ruach kudesha:

Vehakkol nishma bet paro. ribbi (elazar) abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 84:3) nichsefa vegam kalta nafshi lechatzrot Adonai libbi uvesari yerannenu el el chay. ta chaze, kol bar nash detzalle tzeloteh (vekam) kamme mareh, itzterich leh leakdama leh birchan bechol yoma veyoma, uletzalle tzeloteh kamme mareh bezimna deitzterich.

Betzafra, leachada bimina dekudesha berich hu. bemincha, leachada bismala. utzelota uvauta, itzterich leh levar nash bechol yoma veyoma begin leitachada beh. veokimna, man detzalle tzeloteh, (vekam) kamme mareh, itzterich leh dela lemishma kaleh bitzloteh. uman deashma kaleh bitzloteh, tzeloteh la ishtema.
418: (Shemot 202 amud bet) ditzlota, lav ihi hahi kala deishtema. dehahu kol deishtamma lav hi tzelota. uman ihi tzelota. da kala ochora, detalya bekala deishtema, uman hu kala deishtema. da hahu kol dehu beVav, kala detalya beh, da hahu kol bela vav.

Uvegin kach, la itzterich leh levar nash lemishma kaleh bitzloteh, ella letzallaa belachash, behahu kala dela ishtema. veda hi tzelota deitkabbalat tadir. vesimanich, vehakkol nishma, kol bela vav, nishma. da hi tzelota dehi bachashay. dichtiv bechanna, (Shmuel 1 1:13) vekolah lo yishshama. da hi tzelota dekudesha berich hu kabbil, kad itavid go reuta vechavvavna vetikkuna kedka yeut, uleyachada yichuda demareh kedka yaot bechol yoma. (vehakkol nishma bet paro. vehakkol nishma chaser vav, may tama, amar rabbi elazar, da hi shechinta debachat al charuv bi makdesha veal galutehon deyisrael. ketiv hacha, vehakkol nishma, uchetiv hatam, 1 kol barama nishma. ma lehallan shechinta, af kan nammi shechinta).
Ribbi elazar amar, kala bachashay, da hi kala illaa, dechol kalin nafkin mittamman. aval kol bela 6, da hi tzelota diltatta, deihi azla leistalleka beVav uleitchabbera beh.

Ta chaze, vehakkol nishma, da hu kol bela vav. da hi kala debachat al mikdash rishon veal mikdash sheni. nishma, kema deat amer, kol berama nishma. berama, may berama. da hu alma illaa, alma deate. vesimanich, min harama vead bet el, (Tehillim 106:48) min haolam vead haolam. hacha berama, da alma illaa. deha behahi shata di berama nishma. keden ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 22:12) vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped vegomer.

Vehakkol nishma, leela leela. may tama. begin devv itrachak veistallak minneh, ucheden rachel mevakka al baneha meana lehinnachem al baneha ki enenu. ki enennu, ki enam mibbae leh. ella ki enennu, veha okimna, ki enennu, devaalah la ishtakkach immah. deillemale baalah yishtakkach immah, titnachem alayyhu. deha keden benaha, la yehon begaluta. uvegin deenennu, lav ihi mitnachama al benaha, begin divnaha itrachaku minnah, al deenennu immah.

Ta chaze, bet paro, da hu simanich leela, beta deitperau veitgalleyayn minneh kol nehorin vechol butzinin, kol ma dehava satim, mittamman itgeli. uvegin kach, kudesha berich hu appik kol nehorin vechol butzinin, begin leanhara lehahu kol, deikre kol bela vav.

Ta chaze, kad yakim kudesha berich hu lehay kol meafra, veyitchabbar beVav, keden kol ma deitavid minnayyhu bezimna degaluta, yithadar veyitaddenun binhorin illain deittosfan miggo alma illaa. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 27:13) vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol uvau haovdim beeretz ashshur vehanniddachim beeretz mitzrayim vehishtachavu laAdonai behar hakkodesh birushalam:

Veatta tzuvveta zot asu kechu lachem meeretz mitzrayim vegomer. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Yeshayahu 66:10) simchu et yerushalam vegilu vah kol ohaveha sisu ittah masos vegomer. ta chaze, kad itcharav be makdesha vegarmu chovin, veitgalu yisrael meara, (Vayikra 75 amud alef) istallak kudesha berich hu leela leela, vela ashgach al charuv be makdesha, veal ammeh deitgalu, ucheden shechinta itgalleyay immehon.

Kad nachat, ashgach al beteh deittokad, istakkal al ammeh veha itgeli. shaal al matronita veittarchat. keden vayyikra Adonai elohim tzevaot bayyom hahu livchi ulemisped ulekarecha velachagor sak. vehi gam hi ma ketiv bah, (Yoel 1:8) eli kivtula chagurat sak al baal neureha. kema deat amer ki enennu, begin deistallak minah, veishtakkach piruda.

Veafillu shemaya veara, kullehu itabbalu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam. malache illae kullehu itabbalu aleh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutztza malache shalom mar yivkayun. shimsha vesihara itabbalu vechashchu nehorehon. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 13:10) chashach hashshemesh betzeto vegomer, vecholla illae vetattae, bachu alah
419: Veitabbalu. may tama, begin deshalta alah sitra ochora, deshalta al ara kaddisha.

Patach veamar, (Yechezkel 7:2) veatta ben adam ko amar Adonai elohim leadmat yisrael ketz ba hakketz al arba kanfot haaretz. hay kera raza illaa ihu. leadmat yisrael ketz, may ihu. vechi admat yisrael ketz hi. ella hachi hu vadday veittemar, ketz ihu limina, ketz ihu lismala. ketz limina, dichtiv, (Daniel 12) leketz hayyamin. ketz lismala, dichtiv, (Iyov 28:3) ketz sam lachoshech ulechol tachlit hu choker, veda hu (Bereshit 6:13) ketz kol basar, kema deittemar.

Ketz dimina, hayeynu dichtiv leadmat yisrael ketz. ba hakketz, da ketz dismala. ketz dimina, da ketz deyetzer hattov. ketz dismala, da ketz deyetzer hara, veda ihu dechad chovin garmu veitgabberu, itgezar veityeyhiv shaltana lemalchut harshaa leshaltaa, ulecharava beteh umikdesheh. veda hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 7:Adonai) ko amar Adonai elohim raa achar raa hinne vaa, vecholla chad.

Uvegin kach, itabbalu illae vetattae al deityeyhiv shaltano lehay ketz dismala. uvegin kach, kevan demalchu kaddisha, malchut shamayim itkafya, umalchut chayyayva (achara) itgabbar. (keden) it leh lechol bar nash, leitabbala immah, uleitkafya immah. uvegin dechad ihi yizdakkefa, vealma yitchadde, yitchadde ihu bahadah. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:10) sisu ittah masos kol hammitabbelim aleha.

Ta chaze, ketiv behu bemitzrayim, (yirmeya 46) egla yefifiya mitzrayim. veraza deegla da, havu yisrael techot shaltaneh kamma zimnin vechamma shenin. uvegin dizminin yisrael leshalletaa levatar alah, itremiz lon hasheta agalot.

Ribbi elazar amar, remez ramaz leh yosef leyaakov al egla arufa. deha behahu pirka itperash minneh. veukemuha, egla arufa, deihi atya al deishtakkach katola, vela ityeyda man katil leh. uvegin dela yishletun al ara ruchin bishin dela itzterichu, yahavin hay egla letikkuna, begin dela yishtemodun legabbeh, vela yishletu alayyhu. (leel 114 amud alef)
Ta chaze, kol bene nasha kullehu avrin al yede demalach hammavet, bar mehay deakdimu leh bene nasha, ad la yimte zimna leshalletaa beh velitol reshu. deha la shallit bevar nash, ad denatil reshu.

Uvegin kach, it leh dina leshalletaa al hahu atar. kema deat amer, (Devarim 21:1) lo noda mi hikkahu. hachi name it leh dina dela ityeyda, begin lekatrega al hahu atar. veal da, (Devarim 21:3) velakchu zikne hair hahi eglat bakar vegomer. begin leaavara dineh dehahu atar, uleittakkana dela yishlot beh mekatrega, uleishtezava minneh.

Ta chaze, yosef kad itperash meavoy, bela levaya, uvela achila ishtaddar, vehava ma dehava. vechad amar yaakov, (Bereshit 37:35) tarof toraf yosef, amar, ki ered el beni avel sheola, deana garimna leh. vetu, dahavena yada daachoy sanyayn leh, veshaddarna leh. veremez ka ramiz leh.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, inun agalot al pi paro shaddar lon, dichtiv vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro. amar leh, diyyuka demilla, dichtiv veatta tzuvveta zot asu. veatta tzuvveta dayyka, uvegin kach ketiv beHei, mashma deyosef tava lon, uvegin kach vayyitten lahem yosef agalot al pi paro. veyaakov la itkeyyaym bemilla, ad dechama lon. dichtiv, vayyar et haagalot asher shalach yosef laset oto vattechi ruach yaakov avihem.

Amar rabbi shimon, bekadmita vattechi ruach yaakov, ulevatar vayyomer yisrael rav od yosef beni chay. ella, bekadmita kare leh orayyta yaakov, begin shuttafuta, deishtattefu shechinta behahu cherem, kad izdabban yosef. vehasheta dishchinta salka, keden ihu, vattechi ruach yaakov avihem, veda hu raza dishchinta. uvatar deihi kayyma bekiyyuma, (begin) keden darga dilela, itavar legabbah, darga deihu yisrael. (nusach acher keden darga dilella, ittear legabbah, veihu darga deyisrael) mikkan, dedarga dilela la itar leela, ad deitar bekadmita letatta, deha hacha vattechi ruach
420: Vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayla, bemarat ketiv. ta chaze, vayyizbach zevachim lelohe aviv yitzchak, bekadmita. begin leitara semala beraza dirchimu. ucheden vayyomer elohim leyisrael bemarot hallayla, behay darga dekaamaran deihi marot hallayla.

Vayyomer anochi hael elohe avicha, may tama. begin desitra dikdushsha dilela, hachi hu. deha sitra dimsaava, la adkar shema dekudesha berich hu, vechol setar dikdushsha idkar bishmeh. anochi ered immecha mitzrayma vegomer, mikkan, dishchinta nachatat immeh begaluta, uvechol atar deyisrael itgalu, shechinta itgalleya immehon, veha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, kamma agalot havu. shit. kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 6) shesh eglot tzav. davar acher, shittin havu, vecholla raza chada. bekadmita ketiv baagalot asher shalach yosef, ulevassof asher shalach paro. ella, kullehu deshaddar yosef, havu bechushebana kedka chaze. veinun deshaddar paro yattir minnayyhu, la havu beraza da, vela havu bechushebana.

Veillen veillen kaatu. begin kach, asher shalach yosef, asher shalach paro. vechad yifkun yisrael min galuta ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:20) veheviu et kol achechem mikkol haggoyim mincha laAdonai vegomer:

Vayyeesor yosef merkavto, ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Yechezkel 1:22) udemut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach hannora natuy al rashehem millemala, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, it chayya leel min chayya, veit chayya kaddisha dekayyma al rish chevata.

Veit chayya illaa, leela al kol shear chevata, vehay (nusach acher veit) chayya shalta al kullehu. begin dechad hay chevata yahava venahara lechullehu, keden kullehu natlin lematlanoy, vihivat da leda, veshalta da al da.

Veit chevata leela al tattae, al shear chevata letatta, vechullehu ittezanu minah, ved sitre dealma reshimin bah. anpin nehirin yedian (dinin) lechol setar, veihi shalta al 4 sitre. veha ukemuha, deinun 3 listar da, veg listar da, vechen led sitrin dealma.

(Shemot 212 amud alef) veit rakia leel min rakia, vehay rakia deshalta alayyhu, kullehu mistakkelan legabbeh. ma ketiv, (Yechezkel 1:23) vetachat harakia kanfehem yesharot ishsha el achotah vegomer. begin dechullehu shaltin al ma deitpakdu, ushelichu dekuseta dekufetra behu.
Veinun lechol setar tisha, (9) led sitrin dealma, veinun 36 bechushebna. vechad mitchabberan kullehu, itavidu reshima chada beraza dishma chada, beyichuda shelim kidkachaze.

Vechad mittakne legabbe karseya, ma ketiv. umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav millemala, veha okimna (nusach acher diyyukena) dehay even tava becharseya dekayyma al 4 kayymin, veal hahu karseya diukena deadam, leitchabbera beh kechada, uleitbarcha kedka yeut.

Vechad ihi mittakna legabbeh deadam, lemeheve kolla reticha (nusach acher kaddisha, vechohen kolla reticha) chada, lehay adam. keden ketiv, vayyeesor yosef merkavto da tzaddik. vayyaal likrat yisrael aviv goshna. likrat yisrael, da raza deadam. goshna, tikruveta chada, leitkerava kechada, bekarbana chada veyichuda chada.

Vayyera elav, dechad itchaze shimsha besihara, keden nahir sihara veanhir lechullehu diltatta. vechen kegavvna da, kol zimna dikdushsha dilela shara al makdesha diltatta, itnehir be makdesha vekayyma bishlimuteh. vechad istallak minneh veitchariv be makdesha, keden, vayyevchi al tzavvarav od. devachun kolla al makdesha deitchariv. od, may od. da galuta batraa.
Keden kevan dechama yaakov veistakkal deha tikkuna diltatta ishtachlal kegavvna dilela, keden amar amuta happaam vegomer. ki odcha chay, deitkayymat beraza divrit kaddisha,
421: Deikre chay haolamim, uvegin kach ki odcha chay. veal da bekadmita amar, rav od yosef beni chay, deitzterich lemekam beraza dechay, veha ittemar.
Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayvarech yaakov et paro, amar ribbi yose, paro af al gav deukemuha beraza ochara, semech deka samchinan bealma.

Aval ta chaze, (Shir HaShirim 1:9) lesusati berichve faro dimmitich raayati, ta chaze, it retichin lismala beraza desitra ochora, veit retichin limina beraza dilela dikdushsha, veillen lokovel illen. illen derachame veillen dedina.

Vechad kudesha berich hu avad dina bemitzrae, kol dina deavid, kehahu gavvna deinun retichin mammash, uchegavvna dileh dehahu sitra mammash. ma hahu sitra (mammash) katil veappik nishmatin, uf kudesha berich hu avid behahu gavvna mammash. dichtiv, (Shemot 13:15) vayyaharog Adonai kol bechor, vechen kolla bemitzrayim, behahu gavvna mammash. uvegin kach dimitich raayati, kegavvna dilah mammash lekatla. dichtiv, ki ani Adonai ani hu velo acher. ulezimna deate ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra vegomer.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen vayyeachazu vah vayyifru vayyirbu meod. vayyeachazu vah, achsanat almin. veyyeachazu bah, deha lehon itchaze, kema deukemuha. (davar acher 33 amar rabbi yose) vayyifru vayyirbu meod, vday, deha tzaara la sharat behu, vekayyme betafnuke alma, uvegin kach vayyifru vayyirbu meod. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen:
422: Hahi sefekan deamin, sappirin dechurese yekara. vela mata lehon shum enish, la min illaa vela min tattaa, ella 18. veraza da, ki lo yirani haadam vachay.

Kamma hu raza illaa beda kera, veanan chavrayay temehin alayyhu, al vaychi dedachir immeh yaakov. hava leh lememar kamme yisrael. yisrael minnayin, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:3) kodesh yisrael laAdonai reshit vegomer. (Shemot 4) beni bechori yisrael. ribbi elazar bereh deribbi shimon amar, vechi la amar kera, (Bereshit 25:33) vayyimkor et bechorato leyaakov.
Amar ribbi shimon avuha, beidna dehavu yisrael keshitin vezakkain veavdin zechu, vela havu retitin yisrael, ella yaakov lechudeh. bedin tavan deavdin, hava lemebad lehu tavan saggiin da beda.

Middechavu, veitgeliu al chovehon, veal ovadehon bishin, la havu savlin yateh, dela yehevyayn lealma, bekusheta al chovehon. veal da ate mechilta derachame vedina lechud, yisrael, veyahavit (veyisrael yehavit) yathon beara galutehon.
Yaot bae beri, aval inish mistakkel veyinda yateh, yaakov demitlaf im vaychi, kodesh. veal dena raza amrin, yaakov bachar yateh sappira bechurese yekara.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 57:15) veet dakka ushefal ruach lehachayot ruach shefalim ulehachayot lev nidkaim. lev nidkaim, da yaakov. kema deat amer, techot min darga nechitat alohi neviin birchan bemitzrayim.
Tana amar ribbi abba, libba chama, deyaakov dehava bemitzrayim let nevuateh maalyuta. (sefer acher deara saneyah) ara saggia.

Ta chaze, la zache levarech lechad mibbenohi, vela hava bideh rucha levarech ella bemitzrayim, kad barich yathon kol chad vechad beraza. veraza (Bereshit 42:1) vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim vayyomer yaakov levanav lamma titrau. ta chaze, dela ityeyhivat nevuata, ella litvire libba. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 42:2) redu shamma veshivru lanu mishsham venichye velo namut.

Amar ribbi yose, techot karse yekara kaddisha, yaakov sappir, deihi mechilata dedina lesitreh, ata amar, (Bereshit 32:29) lo yaakov yeamer od shimmecha ki im yisrael ki sarita im elohim veim anashim vattuchol. at mashkach deyaakov chaza lesitreh mechilata dedina, vayyizrach lo hashshemesh kaasher avar et penuel vegomer, veraza demilla (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzillele arev.

Ribbi shimon amar, kad itgeliu min yerushelem, veaadiu tedira, vesaiv mesana yat hechala. beiddana hahi la sovlat malchuta leyisrael al chovehon, ella yisrael. begin dehi mittere gisa, rachame vedina.

Umilla delo yaakov yeamer od shimcha ki im yisrael, kad itperish bisvireh. yisrael yaakov illaa da min da, uveginehon hava chutera demoshe gelifa mitteren sitroy mishmeh kaddisha, chad rachame bedina, vechad dina bedina.
