Veraza (Bamidbar 23:21) lo hibbit aven beyaakov velo raa amal beyisrael, middaanan begaluta, dechikan ben sane, veistallikat matronita min malka, veitrechikat minneh, hu yashre shechinta benana veyifrekinana. veraza (Yeshayahu 45:13) ko amar Adonai melech yisrael vegoalo Adonai tzevaot. vaychi chay, (Yeshayahu 66:1) ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay.
Binyan illaa, shete raglay chay, 40 rabbata, 10 lech zeerta, 8 letoyv, 16 lev, 6 led, hada hu denafik meillaa.
Techot karseh yekara, meeven tava beeretz mitzrayim. hayeynu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 19:22) venagaf Adonai et mitzrayim vegomer, 12 perisha. (Yeshayahu 26:19) ki tal orot tallecha 1 begin perisha.

Uvegin da mitchalaf kechada, 2 perisha galuta, 1 perisha kadmayyta. ta chaze, may dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:Adonai) bet yaakov lechu venelcha beor Adonai, begaluta, atvavn deitgezar alehon, al chovehon, bekusheta bedina havu, beorayyta takkanta, vetifkun min chamra tina, dehi galuta, vetahachu lenahara daAdonai.
1 Retzono lomar baaretz, ittzappe ata betigna desifra deorayyta. veana itpalig baaretz, baaretz at mashkach betigna desifra deorayyta, 290 mitlappin kechada galuta. may galuta demitzrae. arba
423: Mea shenin hava amar leavraham, dihe galuta livnohi bemitzrae, vechi havet maneta yathon, matan vetishin shenin havu.

Ta chaze, vayyamat yosef ben mea veeser shanim. ribbi shimon patach veamar, (yeshaya 6) hinne haalma hara veyoledet ben vekarat shemo immanuel, idduy veleda, deitmele legilluyan veaktan saggiin veidan bishin. veaf al gav diyhu beillen, matrunita izdazeat veitrachakat min baalah, tehe immana begaluta, ben mea veeser hava gillufa deittosaf, yitree lememar vehava avar min galuta mea veeser shenin, umatan vetishin, havi arba mea shenin, vela itmene galuta deyaakov, ella middemit yosef, (vehayeynu da al gabbe da deamar umeet husar hattamid velatet shikkutz shavemam vegomer.)

Vayyehi yeme yaakov shene chayyav sheva shanim vearbaim umeat shena, hacha raza begaluta beminyeyna, tikuneta yehon benayay deitgalleyayn bemichilata dedina telata gallavavn. kadmaa demitzrae, deitmetal bishva shenin. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:7) hishbati etchem benot yerushalam bitzvaot o beaylot vegomer.

Ribbi shimon amar mehacha, (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li veahavat olam ahavtich vegomer. hacha raza begaluta takkanta yehon benohi deyisrael. mishtere gallayay veyitree lememar, yehon benaya kaddisha deitgallavavn al chovehon bedina, shenin saggiin yehe. (Vayikra 26:21) sheva kechattotechem, (Bereshit 4:24) ki shivatayim yukkam kayin, begaluta kadmaa demitzrae, dehi zeera.
Tinyayna, galuta deshoftim, deitmetal learbaim shenin, bishva deinhu saggie minneh.
Telitae, galuta daanan beh aricha, deitmetal lima shenin, learbein vehayeynu da al gabbe ilaa deamar (Daniel 12:11) umeet husar hattamid velatet shikkutz shomem vegomer:

Vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut. ribbi chizkiyya amar, chama da akta degaluta dehava aran livnohi, keriva anafsheh udechikat limmat, la ishtaar chay, kad hava nachit midargin, bedil chovehon deyisrael, la nachit immehon begaluta, zakkaa chulekehon, dei la nachit immehon begaluta, ishattaaran bene ammaya, veat amart (Yeshayahu 50:2) maddua bati veen ish karati veen on. veen one, da yisrael, bati veen ish, da shechina. hakkatzor katzra yadi mippedut veim en bi koach lehatztzil hen begaarati achariv yam asim neharot midbar. kudesha berich hu yahav chulaka leyisrael dela yishlot ravrevana ochora vehon. nachatu legaluta, shechinta immehon vehu rachik mimmatronita:
Vayyikra livno leyosef vayyomer lo im na matzati chen beenecha, chakar yat benohi kullehon, veamar lehon, aktan saggiin, bishin ravrevin, chamit lemeal livrechon ashkechan rachame illae.

Vei attun baan lemeppak mikkol akta, kayymu li, vehavu benana ribbon alma vetaavdun keshot vedina, vetehve kaavahatchon, ufakkide bechol dar vedar deyete batrechon, vei attun baan lemebad hachi, tifkun mikkol akta deyete alechon.
Ribbi shimon amar, (Amos Adonai:15) vehatztzigu vashshaar mishpat ulay yechonan Adonai elohe tzevaot sheerit yosef. (deitkeriu benohi yisrael kullehon yosef)
Vei taavdun hachi, la tikberun chad min beri, ella itti tetuvun learachon bishlama.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:2) sim na yadcha tachat yerechi, mahu yadcha. patach veamar, (Tehillim 45:4) chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha, sayyfa dekay bah chesed veemet, teren sefiran sefiran, vela shavkin da leda. veal da amar, (Tehillim 89:15) chesed veemet yekadmu fanecha, (Eicha 4:16) pene Adonai chillekam. vei havu tavan benohi, veavidu ma dekayymu, la mit chad mibbenayyhu bemitzrae, dechol tav vetav degazir shema delaha al enasha, la have ella al dihon tavin. vei la, la. kema deamar david, (Melachim 1 2:4) lemaan yakim Adonai et devaro asher dibber alay lemor im yishmeru vanecha et darkam lalechet lefanay beemet. vei la, la (mayyte birchan deamar alehon).
Ta chaze, kamma hu adif rucha deabba merucha devara. derucha deabba hu rucha divra, rucha merucha salka. vei sayyat avira ochora berucha, la nafik shelim.
424: Deha chasir hu behay avira. vehayeynu (Yirmeyahu 2:24) pere limmud midbar beavvat nafshah shaafa ruach.

Tana, (Vayikra 75 amud bet, 370 ki sham ba kol hainyan bashelamevatev) rav hamenuna sava azal lekappotkiyyay, al lekammayyhu rav yiyisa sava. amar leh, bemay askitu. vavy leh, vavy lenafsheh. i ishtelaf rucha dimsaava deishtakkach immeh veorit leh livreh. vehay ihu dekudesha berich hu let leh chulaka. shavik leh chulaka shavik leh leshetzaa leh lealma deate. amar leh, mena lach ha. amar leh, hacha olifna, dehay yeruta bishta, achsenin (achare mot 76 amud alef) kullehu benoy i la yetuvun, deha let milla kayyma kame teshuva. veana hachi olifna, deha asvavta da yahavu li zimna chada, dehavena reshim beanpi, veyoma chad havena azil bearcha vearana bechad zakkaa, veal yedoy itavar minay hahu reshima. amar leh ma shemach, amar leh elazar, vekarena leh elazar ochora, amar leh berich rachamana dechamena lach, zakkaa chulakach bealma den, uvealma deate:

Vayyomer hishshava li vegomer. ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 62:8) nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo, kiyyem kudesha berich hu deyippuk leyisrael min galuta dilhon, veda kiyyem lehon, keyaym, dela yishbok lon beara sanehon.
(Bereshit 32:27) vayyomer shalcheni ki ala hashshachar vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani. man berachtani. yahav lon galuta, vekkiyyem lon deyifkun minneh.

Tana, zammin kudesha berich hu livrehon deyisrael, dihon kol chad vechad techot karseh, vihon maalyayn mikkol illae, begin da tishkach vav aricha. kiyyem kudesha berich hu lishlemuta dev der uvegin shitta vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta. segid yisrael delete meshicha besof minyayna da, vetishre shechinta immehon.

Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vayyomer leyosef hinne avicha chole vegomer: matnitin, amar ribbi chizkiyya, la ata kera leashmuinan deavad, ella ata kera leatya ma deyehve besof galuta, kol illen lesof minyayna deitmene. tzave lememar deyete meshicha, veyema leh avuch devishmayay bahil lisvar appach, safin lekitztza dimshicha. yehe raava min eloha dishmaya, deyissav bereh deasgiu begaluta, umiddeitneshiu behu, denashe yathon kudesha berich hu bechovehon bekusheta.

Kad ata ribbi abba amar, lav lidrasha ka atina, chashov raza demilleta (Bereshit 30:24) yosef Adonai li ben acher, kidfarishna leel, hay shemeh kaddisha beyosef, Yahu yomar, ha avuch mare alma, deate lemebad tava livreh, deyifkun min galuta dilhon. vei at la rae bekushetach, ribbua Adonai echad yaaved yatach, veyade detetuv matronita leatra.
Daavohotana inun retichin dilela, (Bereshit 17:22) vayyaal elohim meal avraham, avahan shoke alma, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov chesed leavraham, tana deyete meshicha.

Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Zecharya 4) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai lo yom velo layla vehaya leet erev yihye or. rotze lememar, teren mearin bishin deatan livnohi lemehve begaluta beara sanehon, vela yisteche behon, kamma shenin saggiin, al chovehon bekusheta, hachi yiznach yathon beara sanehon. veyissav benayyhu deara lehon bishin illen, veyadber lehon laara tav kefirusha dikra.
Vehava tere ravrevan saggiin maalyayn hava metarkan techot karse yekara, deappatroppa deyisrael mechilata chamishaa, bedil diyhon begaluta kol iddana haden, veara denashe yathon beara sanehon.

Vehu teren mechilatan, bitren safin, nafak chada umallil lokovel ribbon alma, veyahiv leh reshu dimallel kol man devae, vechaze beyisrael min gisa chada lemigzar behon beyisrael, deyifkun min galuta, bedin avahathon. umin gisa acharina, raa lemigzar alehon, bedil chovehon, deamru alayyhu bisha saggia. ha 4 mechilatan, vela hava behon mechilata chamishaa appatroppa deyisrael, umallilu kol diru.
425: Ad demata levavthon mechilata chamishaa, vehava becharse yekara min shema kaddisha, veamar al benohi deyisrael tav, vela havu ratyayn teren mechilatan kammayyta lemallala kammeh, bedin mechilata chamishaa deitmetal lelelya, venafak linhora dilhon. veal da patach, vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai lo yom velo layla vehaya leet erev yihye or.

Tanina (Bereshit 1:Adonai) vayyikra elohim laor yom velachoshech kara layla, vehatam amar vechoshech al pene tehom, vekashya dideh adideh. ata ribbi elazar leribbi shimon avoy, veamar leh abba mari, may da. amar leh, mibbereshit ad 6 dorot bara Adonai echad, tzave lememar, 6 dishmeh, yahav beh ruach chachma, ad hacha la hava minda mahu choshech. kam ribbi elazar venashak yedoy deavoy.

Kam ribbi abba veshaal, may choshech. istacharu chavraya vela matu may deshaalu, avadu ovada, umata kala min kodam ribbon alma, behay kera, (Iyov 10:22) eretz efata vegomer tzalmavet velo sedarim, vattofa kemo ofel, gehinnom mikkamme deitbere alma, hava ganiz lerashshiayya, vavy lehon lechayyayvaya, dihon kad yaavid elaha yat illen, (Yeshayahu 60:2) ki hinne hachoshech yechasse eretz vaarafel leummim vealayich yizrach Adonai uchevodo alayich yerae. zakkaa chulekehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu la bara lehon da, (Tehillim 144:15) ashre haam shekkacha lo ashre haam sheAdonai elohav:

Vayyagged leyaakov vayyomer hinne bincha yosef ba elecha. ribbi yose amar, malacha hu, dehava atid lememar tav al bene yisrael, kad yetivun lekudesha berich hu, bechol akathon, kad yete kitztza dimshicha, bechol akta detete alehon, yemrun limchilata berich ati levatach, veyitparkun tavay.
Zakkaa chulekehon deyisrael, deitkeriu benoy dekudesha berich hu, deinun kemalachayay, (Iyov 38:7) vayyariu kol bene elohim, 26 may.

Ta chaze, minnayin shekkara kudesha berich hu leyaakov el, at beillaa, veana ehe betattaa, (nusach acher et tehe batetaah, vaana ehe elaha beilaa), may ka mayyre. (Bereshit 17:22) vayyaal elohim meal avraham, avahatan inun retichan dekudesha berich hu. tana, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov chesed leavraham, ha teren sefiran, bitren retichan, ravrevan illain.

Telitaa yitzchak, may (Bereshit 31:53) vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak. uvegin pachad yitzchak dehava sefira, vekudesha berich hu dehu karse yekara reticha illaa, usefira deyitzchak hi meillaa, mefarsha yattir mikkol sefiran daavahata, hada hu dichtiv vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak.
Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Bereshit 31:53) elohe avraham velohe nachor yishpetu benenu elohe avihem, vayyishshava yaakov befachad aviv yitzchak, mehay kera at yachil leminda da.

Vayyitchazzek yisrael vayyeshev al hammitta, veraza dikra, (Daniel 12:1) baet hahi yaamod michael hassar haggadol haomed al beni ammecha vehayta et tzara. ribbi shimon amar, da gevurat yeda demichael ravreva. vayyeshev al hammitta, kemma leh hava mikkaddemat dena segid. leman hava segid, segid learsa, hava arsa peticha minneh. lemahuleta hava segid, deha havat chaviva minneh.

(Malachi 2:11) ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai asher ahev uvaal bat el nichar, kad istallak ziveh minneh al chovehon, la hava leh lemekam kammeh, veittarchat matronita min malka, bedil dela yachla leshavka lah livraha ben amin lemiktallehon, vehava beara kaddisha hu, beha dihon ammin nucherain min ammeh. tzave lememar, al shechinta benehon begaluta, veiddana dela hava beara, vehi baara ammemin, beziva deyisrael, istammaru ammemayya di vesachranihon.

Tana, amar ribbi yose, teren ravrevin havu techot karse yekara kaddisha, veha bishmeh chad mani bearsa, dehava shade agozzeh dehechala. veha anan begaluta, la ishtaar benana ella da debene dezineh, vehu chatuch min shemeh dekudesha berich hu.

Hada hu dichtiv, (shamevatekag) hinne anochi sholeach malach lefanycha lishmarcha vegomer, la lemallala hachi, ella bealma deate, kad parishna besitrin vehu tzurin vearcha, ana sharena shechinta benichon lemarehon begaluta vehi natrat yatchon, ad
426: Detete yatchon learachon, kema dehavitun mikkadmat dena. asher hachinoti, motavan mikkadmat dena.

Da shechinta min 314. veittarchat matronita min malka, ad detetuv leatraha, veraza (Devarim 3:11) ki rak og melech habbashan nishar miyyeter harfaim hinne arso eres barzel halo hiv berabbat bene ammon, kidfarishna beatreh.
Vearcha, deitmetal legaluta, natar yathon begaluta, al akta detete alechon, ad deyete veyeul yatchon leara, dekayyaym laavahatchon deitnatrat.

Ravreva tinyana hu, dehu techot karse kaddisha, deshare begazzeh dehechala hu nuriel. deha ravreva deyisrael deitmanne alehon, bechol idan dahavat matronita im malka, hava nafek veal kodamehon, 314. vehu, kavel pulechanhon lekudesha berich hu, kenura. kad itbatel nura veitgaliu, istallak zivah, veistalleka matronita min malka.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar (Rut 3:13) lini hallayla vehaya babboker im yigalech tov yigal, amar ribbi yose, shallit rachame al dina. (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov, tov veor shavin, dehu mabbuoy denachalin, denafak minnehon yamma venachala divalma.

Tana amar ribbi shimon, zimna chada salikna venachitna leanhara bemabbue denachalin, vesalik batray ribbi abba. amar li, bemay askitu. amarit leh, behay kera (Kohelet 1:7) dechol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam ennnu male. mizzivih itberiu kol ravrevayay demin alma, umin ziveh itneviu kol nachalayay, nachalayay havu inun lehay kera, demeiche behay galuta, deha chashocha kamufela, chibbata deimma avid lehu, vei lav, nachala avid beratteh. ravreva taninota hu, hu techot kaddisha, degane agnim dehechala. deha ravreva deyisrael deitmanne alehon, bechol idan dehavat matronita im malka, hava nafik veal kodamehon 314. vehu kabbil pulechanhon lekudesha berich hu kenura. kad itbatil nura veitgaliu, istallak zivah, veistalleka matronita min malka. ha la hava shelim ad deyete gisa ochora, dela hava begaluta manita.
Ushemahan deitkeriat yad, hi mabbua lecholla, vetishkach yad 26, (Yeshayahu 59:1) hen la katzrat yad 26, dela idkar yada ella bishma dechad.

Ata ribbi elazar, veshaal leribbi shimon avoy, uvecha veamar leh, galle li hay raza abba mari. amar leh behay kera itgeli lach, (Shemot 17:16) ki yad al kes yah milchama laAdonai, kes begin 26, shallit rachame al dina. tzave lememar, yehe raava diyhe lealma beatar gevurat, yad Adonai rabbata kerava dehavat bemitzrayim, vei lav havu bedine.

Veyete meshicha, yete bechadtu bida rabbata, veyiggach kerava baamalek. (Shemot 13:9) bechozek yad hotziacha Adonai mimmitzrayim, vechad yete shema deyad betukefa yeda lechudeh, hu beidana, deyaggiach kerava baamalek, lete meshicha. ribbi elazar mesayyea, (Zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem keyom hillachamo beyom kerav. 80 begin Adonai.

Ta chaze, kamma hi yeda rabbata dela mata lehay yada illaa, laavahan ravreva la agnim. uveda yada nafku mimmitzrayim, begin demishveyayn shavin, manni 4 led, shavin da dera, shema deyada rabbata, deyifuk min inun shavin beatvavthon deminyaynehon keminyaynehon, dekibbela teren yad, teren.

Ketzad la itmenau da min da, vela shavin. itperash teren illen berich hu divatvavthon sayyan yad baalah Adonai, teren leav minyanehon mitparash. meillen itberiu shemaya veara udeimmeh. veinun sefira kadmaa, dehi kitra illaa. tinyana, (Mishlei 15:3) bechol makom ene Adonai tzofot raim vetovim. telitaa, hem mesayyaytan lishma chad 6 deavad kamma atvavn beara demitzrayim.
427: Vayyomer yaakov el yosef el shadday nira elay beluz beeretz kenaan. ribbi abba amar, luz da yerushala 40 illaa, deashraa shechinta benaha. amar yaakov illaa letatta, hav li birchata dehu bae, leanpish yatchon ana, ulemittan yat ara livnechon. luz zo yerushala 40 illaa, kudesha berich hu, hav ravreva dehavvyan beracha da al yedeh, beara ravyay, aval bera, leara ochora, la yehe birchata.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Mishlei 27:14) mevarech reehu bekol gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo, kudesha berich hu kara leyisrael achim vereim. may birchata yahav lon, dihon hay amma dachya techot yedeh, velimeheve alehon natir.

Zakkaa chulekehon dehay amma dachya, dehu alehon, deikre vanim chavivim yattir meillaa, ketiv, (Devarim 4) banim attem laAdonai, kolla bedil da. may hu, bedil deishtelim shema bechotama dilhon, deinun gezirin.

Ta chaze, beanpoy deenasha shema dekudesha berich hu, vechasra yod minneh, vela ishtelim. ata avraham vechibbev lekudesha berich hu, veamar leh bach ishtelim shema, veitgezar, veishtelim shema beYod demila. beanpoy deennasha 360 deshdy, ved, chaser yod, ishtelim beYod demila, ucheden ikrun banim laAdonai, benin kaddishin.

Vechad mesaavin leh lehay at kayyayma kaddisha, veail leh lirshu ochora, salik minneh hay kiddusha dechotama, vehu kema dechariv alma, vesaiv chotama, deishtelim beh shema dekudesha berich hu, veha hu chariv alma.

Ribbi abba hava azil mikkappotkiyya, vehava immeh ribbi yose. ad dehavu azle, chamu chad bar nash dehava ate, ureshima chad beanpoy, aval vavy lon lechayyayvaya, dimutun bela teshuva, dela yaade minneh reshima, la bealma den, vela bealma deate:

Vayyomer elay hinneni mafrecha vehirbeticha. ribbi abba patach veamar, hay kera (Yeshayahu 29:22) lo atta yevosh yaakov velo atta panav yechovaru. vechi enish deamar tav lebar nash kavvavteh. i la yashlim ma deamar, appohi mitbayyshan, al achat kamma vechamma min illae lebar nash, dei la mayyte kol tav deamar al benohi, anpohi mitbayyshan.

Amar kudesha berich hu leh, ana yisrael illaa, deana mafshinach veasginach. hay birchata deyahiv li, veetten yat ara hada livrechon, la hava beara, la hava immehon. kad yete kitza dimshicha veyishtelim, amar kudesha berich hu, lo atta yevosh yaakov, kean (lo) anfoy deyaakov dilela, la mitbayyshan middaamar lehon etten, are ad kean la havu bideh, vehavu anpohi mitbayyshan, kean dileh mistayyea min kodam mare shemaya veara.
Kema deamrinan, agachna daamalek, kad yishtelim kitza, la yehe ella bitkof yeda, kema dehavit beyom kerav, veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem, dideh vela ochora:

Veatta shene vanycha hannoladim lecha, da yisrael letatta, deatrehon begaluta, benoy dekudesha berich hu, deityeylidu beni ammaya. tana amar ribbi yose, yisrael kad yehon beara kaddisha deyisrael, dar beara, kad yete meshicha, yehon im achuhon dilavun batrehon. dela itkere galut, ella leman deihu dar beara nucheraa, inun itkaryayn galyayn. (Vayikra 26)

Vezacharti et beriti yaakov, vav yetera, tete vav deistallekat kad itchariv beta, utehe siyyua leyaakov, kad yehe da, vihe livra kaddisha ara achsanat alam, vihon benohi bearahon, dedaru mikkaddemat dena bearahon, zakkaa chulekehon.

Kean barya, dehava aran lehon, tehon azlin ravrevin deitgeliu min levar leara veitneshiu, veanpishu. veyema yaakov illaa letatta, bare dilach deinun levar leara deityeylidu begaluta, bechol ara veara, ad deana iol lemitzrae, veaavid lehon dina
428: Al chovehon, lav ana maskit berach, deitberiu begaluta, levar leara beara rechika. veaf al gav deinun saggiin, veitneshiu, dili inun. kad chazeti da galuta dilhon, veaseti lechevehon, veshamit kalehon. reuven, (Bereshit 29:33) ki raa Adonai et anyi. shimon, ki shama Adonai ki senua anochi, vechashiv belibbach, keillu yehevyayn kodamay inun, umiddintuv mimmitzrae, millemebad dina, nasik yathon meara galuta.

Ribbi abba amar, mehacha (Yeshayahu 66:20) veheviu et kol achechem mikkol haggoyim mincha laAdonai. tzave lememar, kad yehe kudesha berich hu bedina bemitzrae, beiddana hahi yetun kol ammemaya mincha, kad shemau shemua dekudesha berich hu, hayeynu (Yeshayahu 2:2) venaharu elav kol haggoyim.

Tana, amar ribbi shimon, atid kudesha berich hu lemebad lechol zakkaa vezakkaa, chuppa biyrushala 40, (Yirmeyahu 16:9) kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla, kad tituv matronita lemalka, veavid lah erusin, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena vegomer beyom chatunato uveyom simchat libbo. beyom chatunato ze mattan tora, uveyom simchat libbo ze binyan bet hammikdash, sheyyibbane bimhera veyamenu:
Umoladtecha asher holadta acharehem lecha yihyu, da yisrael letatta, laavahan deinun retichin, tehe shemahathon beraza deityaylidu levatar denan, al shema daachehon yehon makrivin beachsana dilhon.

Tana, amar ribbi shimon, umoladtecha, da yerushelam diltatta, (Vayikra 18) moledet bayit befarashat arayot, yerushala 40 letatta, guverin deityeylidu da yerushala 40, batar dena, dituvun alma lemare shemaya birushalam, kad giyyorin la itkarun ella al shemahan, dehu bar yisrael, vela yitkarun kad avahathon, giyyora mikkappotkiyya, ella beha yisrael.

Lecha yihyu, tzave lememar, al shemehon deyisrael yitkarun, al shem achehon yikkaru benachalatam, vechad tavu la yitchasnun illen im yisrael beara, veyissav kol shivta veshivta, dideh veguverin minnehon, kol chada lefum minyayneh.

Vaani bevoi mippaddan meta alay rachel badderech vegomer, ribbi abba patach, (Yirmeyahu 31:15) ko amar Adonai kol berama nishma vegomer, ma ketiv batreh, ko amar Adonai minnei kolech mibbechi veenayich middima ki yesh sachar lifulatech vegomer veshavu vanim ligvulam, lo amar veyashuvu, ella veshavu, kevar shavu.

Ta chaze, amar ribbi elazar, beshata dihe dina al tura, titattar matronita al tura, vehi savrat divnehon avdin bedina, veraza (Yeshayahu 54:1) rani akara lo yalada pitzchi rinna vetzahali vegomer. tana, sagyayn yehon beni kurseyay min didah. hada hu dichtiv, ki rabbim bene shomema mibbeni veula, tituv matronita levaalah, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Min kadmat dena, tema matronita lekudesha berich hu, benayay dili an. yema lah, bedina. hi tisbar deavdin bedina, uvacha al dina livnaya didah, ki are saggi it lach lemesav minni bedilhon, dehavat immehon, veha tavu meara desana.

Vechi la hava yada yosef demeta immeh, taman hava immah kad meta. ella yomar yisrael illaa, kad nete mifraknehon deyisrael, titar matronita, vetitar keneset yisrael, vetiggach kerava im ammamin, vimutun minhon, veyitkarvun bizer lemete ara. yemar lah kudesha berich hu, kad hi bacha. la tidchali, agra lehon benayay demitan al shemi, ochoranin ha tavu, inun yetuvun lechayye metayay.
Meta alay rachel, meta al yichud shema dekudesha berich hu, veal da ittemar beod kivrat eretz lavo, demitu al yichud shema dekudesha berich hu, levar leara, beara da, la yamut chad minnehon.

Tana, amar ribbi abba, atidin yisrael laagacha kerava bearcha deefrat, vimutun amma sagya minnehon, uvatar ken lechayye metaya yekumun. veyattir shaltana yehe lechon demitin bearcha haden, mikkol dihe kadamehon biyrushala 40.
429: Deatra haden lachem. bedil dehu min shema dekudesha berich hu beh, dimutun tamman al shemeh, 14, dimutun tamman al shemeh 15, lechem begaluta, bedil dehu min shemeh dekudesha berich hu:

Vayyar yisrael et bene yosef vayymer mi elle. ribbi abba patach, (Yeshayahu 49:21) veamart bilvavech mi yalad li et elle, may ka mayyre, yisrael letatta, chaze deyetun benohi deyisrael kadameh, kad yetun (Yeshayahu 11:11) meelam umishshinar umechamat umeiyye hayyam veachnashu kullehu vihon saggiin. tema shechinta mean inun kullehon, vela behon pesul mibbeni nucheraa. yiyimrun leh, anachna kullana mibberach, velet bena nucheraa bahadan, deyitparshun da min da vecharat lehon kechada, veyitgayyrun, yetuvun giyyurin im yisrael, vihon kechada.

Tana, kashim gerim leyisrael kesappachat beor hachay, learahon. ketiv (yeshaya 11) ki yerachem Adonai et yaakov uvachar od biyrushala 40 venilva hagger alehem venispechu al bet yaakov, kad yetuvun learahon beraya, vihevyayn rechimu vehon, (Zecharya 14:9) yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad, yitlauun giyyorin im yisrael vihevvyayn lehon keumeka bevisrehon.

Vechol kach lamma. ta shema, amar ribbi shimon, al techumin deara, dechol chad yehe raava lemedar beara deyisrael, vetistaar diyyurin. ketiv, (Yeshayahu 54:2) vitedotayich chazeki, tzave lememar, sichya dehavyayn immach meikkara, atkif yathon, vesayyay yathon yattir mishar ammamin. kivyachol deat sache leittakkefa yathon bechol ammemaya ochora, vihon saggiin:

Vayyomer yosef el aviv banay hem asher natan li elohim baze, ribbi shimon tani mehacha, (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe lifne bene yisrael, yomar yisrael letatta, kad yisrael alehon leela, banay inun, deyahav li kudesha berich hu orayyta, kamma yathon venimusehon keshitin, benimuse orayyta (deityehivat lehon. ta chaze, kad yehon yisrael techot gadpe shechinta, orayyta) dilhon itkeriat ze, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:2) ze eli veanvehu, uvechol iddan dela hava david memallel techot gadfe shechinta da milleta, ella itnabbe ma delehve, itkarena zot.

Rav nachman amar mehacha, (Tehillim 27:3) im tachan alay machan la yira libbi vegomer bezot ani boteach, zot da orayyta tehe leyte meshicha, uvegin da, (Shir HaShirim 2:12) vekol hattor nishma beartzenu. al ma itmatlat orayyta, legozala. ma gozala kaleh arev, af pitgame orayyta kaleh arev, veda kala yehe leyte meshicha, leyoma dedina.
Tana, hannitztzanim niru vaaretz et hazzamir higgia vekol hattor nishma beartzenu. hannitztzanim, da avahatan demerkava, demin alma yekumun veyitchazu.

Et hazzamir higgia, tushebachta dishabbechun levae, kad yetuvun lefulechanehon kidbekadmita. vekol hattor, asher natan li elohim baze, pitgame deorayyta, deinun arevin kekala detora, da ze zot tor shavin.

May ka mayyre. veraza demilleta, beiddana dela tehevyayn techot gadfe shechinta, 1 dilzot nachit, vehu mittechot lecholla, uselikat Adonai, deze eli veanvehu, middecharav beta, deh, la yachla ladur ulemeheve ben ammamin ovde kochavim umazzalot, deh kaddisha chatucha min shema. hei elef, hei adifat bikdushsha, 1 adifat leatvavn. kad yetuvun yisrael learahon, hei kaddisha dehu chatucha min shema dekudesha berich hu, tetuv baze veyippuk (miyyoma dedina, 12 tekabbel) minyayna takanta.

Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 40:12) mi madad beshoolo mayim veshamayim bazzeret tikken, ze tor, shavin kivyachol, 7 ler, Rabbi let, 6 laAdonai, zarta dekudesha berich hu, beshit mea veshivin shenin, mehacha min shemaya, vead ara, ketzad (12) tor, zeret 11 11 607, itkaddemat Adonai lev. veitkkadmat 6 let, 400 ler, Rabbi lez, (Shemot 28:16) ravua yihye kaful zeret arko vezeret rachbo kaful.

Vayyomer kachem na elay vaavarachem, yomar middahavo befitgame orayyta mitassekin, (vahava) vehu da mechilata ben chakkimayhu, avarachinun, veraza (Bereshit 32:28-29) vayyomer elav ma shemecha vayyomer yaakov. vayyomer
430: Lamma ze tishal lishmi, vayyomer yaakov, minyayna da, leminyayna kadmita dekammeh, kedfarishna beatreh.
Veraza ochora, vayyishal yaakov vegomer vayyomer lamma ze tishal lishmi vayvarech oto sham, ha la atid, ella bizchuta deze, levarchehon.

Veraza saggia tinyana, beatra dehay kera, aval la atena lekamman dela leashmuinan hay kera deamarna, mikkameh deamina lach deitkeriat orayyta ze. ketiv, (Shoftim Adonai:Adonai) ze sinay mippene Adonai elohe yisrael, kad ityeyhivat orayyta al yeda demoshe, (Shemot 32:27) ki ze moshe haish (Shemot 15:2) ze eli veanvihu, orayyta hava nachatat min kamme elaha deyisrael.
Veene yisrael kavdu mizzoken vegomer, uvegin da, la at mashkach dechavvavteh, vechad yehon begaluta kol zimna charuva hadin, sivu. la yachlin lemechoze appe shechinta, ad detete rucha ochora behon.

Mikkaddemat dena istaivu baara ammemaya, vela havu benimuse orayyta. kemma diyhon kahil lemehach, vetavu iddana sagge beni nechrain, dara batar dara, veolifu min archehon, kad yetuvun appe shechinta learahon, bekadmita la yachlin lemechome appi shechinta, ad deyahiv kudesha berich hu rucha dileh lehon.

Ribbi chiyyay patach, (Yechezkel 36:27) veet ruchi etten bekirbechem, levatar veasiti et asher bechukkay telechu umishpatay tishmeru vaasitem, min batar deyahav ruchin bechon ukedushsha, benimusay tehachun vetithachun.

Lo yuchal lirot, ribbi abba patach veamar, (Mishlei 16:15) beor pene melech chayyim uretzono keav malkosh, kad yissebrun appe shechinta dekudesha berich hu, veyitassekun beinun retichin deminnehon chevavn dealma.

Ta chaze, la tishkach behanne kerae kullehon lishna, ela leinish, (Tehillim 71:24) gam leshoni kol hayyom tehge tzidkatecha. vela at mashkach behanne kerae bekudesha berich hu, uvegin kach yetuvun learahon, veyahav kudesha berich hu ruach chachmeta behon, lishna dilhon tehevyayn tadir bekudesha berich hu. (74 kan eno min hazzohar):

Vaychi yaakov vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz vegomer, zakkain inun yisrael, yattir mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, dekudesha berich hu kara lon tzaddikim. leachsin lon yerutat almin bealma deate, leitanaga behahu alma, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titanneg al Adonai. may tama. begin demitdabbekin begufa demalka, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

Ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz, hay kera raza illaa ihu ben mechatzde chakla, deha beraza deaggadta tane ribbi shimon. deachsanat yeruta illaa dehahi eretz, let man deyarit lah, bar hahu deikre tzaddik. (sefer acher dehay eretz, velet man deyarit la, bar hahu deikre tzaddik, deha tzaddik yarit lematronita vadday) deha matronita beh itdabbekat leitbassema, vetzaddik yarit lematronita vadday.

Uf hacha, bachavivuta dekudesha berich hu leyisrael, amar, veammech kullam tzaddikim, uvegin kach leolam yirshu eretz, itchazun leyarit lematronita. may tama ikrun tzaddikim, umay tama yartin lematronita. begin deitgazzaru. kema detaninan, kol man deitgezar, veayyil behay (sefer acher berit kaddisha veayil behay) achsana, venatir lehay berit, al veitdabbak begufa demalka, veal behay tzaddik. uvegine kach ikrun tzaddikim, veal da leolam yirshu aretz. may aretz, da eretz hachayyim.

Ahadar veamar, netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. nitzer mattaay, anafa meinun anafin, denata kudesha berich hu kad bara alma. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:8) vayyitta Adonai elohim gan beeden mikkedem, vehay eretz chad minnayyhu. begini kach, nitzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer.
Davar acher, veammech kullam tzaddikim, da yaakov uvenoy denachatu lemitzrayim ben am keshe kedal, veishtakkachu kullehu zakkain. uvegin kach ketiv, leolam
431: Yirshu eretz demmittamman seliku lirayt ara kaddisha.
Vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim, ammay parshata da setima. ribbi yaakov amar, beshata demit yaakov, istimu enehon deyisrael. ribbi yehuda amar, dichden nachatu legaluta, veishtabidu behon.

Ribbi shimon amar, ma ketiv leela, vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen vayyeachazu vah vayyifru vayyirbu meod. uchetiv vaychi yaakov, dela itchaze leafrasha ben da leda. ma inun kayyme betafnukin demalchin, vekabbilu innuga vechissufin legarmayyhu. uf yaakov name, kayyaym betafnuke malchin, beinnuga vechissufa legarmeh, la itperash da min da.

Vehacha ikre vaychi. deha kol yomoy la ikre vaychi, begin dechol yomoy betzaara havu, betzaara ishtakkechan, aleh ketiv, (Iyov 3:26) lo shalavti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez. batar denachat lemitzrayim, ikre vaychi. chama livreh malka, chama lechol benoy zakkain tzaddikin, vechullehu betaanuge vetafnuke alma, vehu yativ benihon kachamar tav deyativ al duredayyeh, keden ikre vaychi yaakov. vela parish ben vayyifru vayyirbu meod levaychi yaakov, vehachi itchaze.

Sheva esre shana, may tama sheva esre shana. ella amar rabbi shimon, kol yomoy deyaakov betzaara havu, betzaara aavar lon bekadmita, kevan dechama leyosef, vehava kaim kammeh, kad yaakov mistakkel beyosef, hava ishtelim benafsheh, keillu chama leimmeh deyosef. deshappiru deyosef dame leshappiru derachel. vehava dame begarmeh kema dela aavar aleh tzaara beyomoy.

Vechad yosef itperash minneh, keden itkeyyaym, lo shalavti velo shakatti velo nachti vayyavo rogez. deda kashya leh leyaakov mikkol ma deavar, uvezimna deitperash yosef minneh, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 37:2) yosef ben sheva esre shana haya roe vegomer. vechol yomin deyaakov, la hava leh tzaara kehay, vehava bache kol yoma leinun sheva esre shana deyosef.

May kaativu leh, (Bereshit 46:4) veyosef yashit yado al enecha, ha lecha sheva esre shana ochoranin, beinnugin vetafnukin vahanaot vechissufin. hada hu dichtiv vaychi yaakov beeretz mitzrayim sheva esre shana vegomer. tana, kol inun shenin, shechinta yekara dekudesha berich hu, immeh ishtakkecha, uvegin kach chayyim ikrun.

Ta chaze, ketiv vattechi ruach yaakov avihem, itchaze deha bekadmita mit hava hahu rucha dileh, vela hava mitkavven lekabbela rucha ochora. deha rucha dilela, la sharya berekanya. amar ribbi yose, shechinta la sharya, ella beatar shelim, vela beatar chaser, vela beatar pagim, vela beatar atziv, ella beatar deitkavvevn, beatar chadu. uvegin kach, kol inun shenin deyosef itperash meavoy, veyaakov hava atziv, la sharya beh shechinta.

Tana, amar ribbi elazar amar ribbi abba, ketiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana. leafaka, delet pulechana dekudesha berich hu, ella miggo chedva. deamar ribbi elazar, let shechinta sharya miggo atzvut, dichtiv (Melachim 2 3:15) veatta kechu li menaggen vehaya kenaggen hamenaggen. menaggen menaggen telat zimne ammay. begin leatara rucha mishlemuta decholla, dehu ruach shelema.

Amar ribbi abba, tamman taninan, mearba sitrin kolla ishtakkach, vechol sharashin deillain vetattain behu achidan. vetana da ayil veda nafik da satim veda parish, itachad chad bachavertah, veinun avahan decholla.

Ribbi shimon amar, (Devarim 10:15) rak baavotecha chashak Adonai, ketiv baavotecha, mammash telata, umashma dichtiv rak, rak mammash, umeillen mitparshan umitachadan kol shear ochoranin, vesalkin shema leitattera.

Tana, amar ribbi yose, min yoma deistallik ribbi shimon min mearta, millin (illen) la itkasyayn min chavraya, verazin illain havu mistakkelan veitgalleyayn mibbenayyhu, keillu ityeyhivu hahi shata betura desinay. batar deshachiv ketiv, (Bereshit 8:2) vayyissachru mayeynot
432: Tehom vaarubbot hashshamayim, vehavu chavrayay merachashan mille, vela mitkayyme behu.
Deyoma chad hava yativ ribbi yehuda, afitcha ditverya, vechama tere gemalle, desalke katfira mealoy dechitfin, nafal matula dekatfira, veatu tzippore. vead la matu alayyhu, itbakkau.

Levatar atu kamma tzipporin, vehavu azle alayyhu, vesharu (nusach acher vashedayav) lon betartisha, vela mitbakkein. vehavu tzavvchin lon, vela havu mitparshan. shamu chad kala, itra deitrin bekidrin sharya, umarih levar.

Ad dehava yativ, avar chad gavra, ashgach behu. amar, la kiyyem da, ha dichtiv, (Bereshit 15:11) vayyered haayyit al happegarim vayyashshev otam avram. amar ribbi yehuda, veha avidna vela itparshan. ahadar resheh hahu gavra veamar, ad la marit da resheh demareh, vead la galish lematronita. rahat avatreh telat millin, vela amar leh. chalash dateh deribbi yehuda.

Yoma chad, idmuch techot ilana, vechama bechelmeh, 4 gadfin mittaknan, vesalik ribbi shimon alayyhu, vesefer tora immeh. vela shavik kol sifre razin illain vaagadta, dela salik lon bahadeh. vesalik lehon (sefer acher vaselaykan leh) lirkia, vechama demitkasya meena, vela itgalya.

Kad itar, amar, vadday middeshachiv ribbi shimon, chachmeta istallekat meara. vavy ledara dehay avna tava, dehavu mitchazan (sefer acher demitachadan) minneh, vesamchin aleh illain vetattain, itavid minnayyhu.

Ata legabbeh deribbi abba, sach leh. salik ribbi abba yedoy al resheh, uvacha veamar, ribbi shimon rechayay detachanin minneh manna tava kol yoma, velaktin leh. kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 11:32) hammamit asaf asara chomarim, vehasheta rechayyay umanna istalleku vela ishtaar bealma mineh, bar kema dichtiv, (Shemot 16:33) kach tzintzenet achat veten shamma melo haomer man vehannach oto lifne Adonai lemishmeret. veillu beitgalleyay la ketiv, ella lemishmeret, leatznauta. hasheta man yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon.

Lachish leh leribbi yehuda bilchishu, (amar leh rabbi abba) vadday hahu gavra dechamit, eliyyahu hava. vela baa legallaa razin, begin detinda shevacha deribbi shimon, dehava beyomoy, veyivkon dara aloy. amar leh, day lemivke bechiyya aleh.

Ribbi yehuda hava bache kol yoma aloy, deha aara immeh beidra kaddisha deribbi shimon, ushear chavrayay. amar leh, vavy dela istallakna hahu yoma im inun telata deistallaku, vela lecheme dara da, deha ithappach.

Amar leh, ribbi ema li, ketiv, (Shemot 29:44) vehem yikchu et hazzahav veet hattechelet veet haargaman veet tolaat hashshani veet hashshesh, veillu kesef la ketiv. veha ketiv zahav vachesef. amar leh veha name nechoshet, dechesef unechoshet bechushbena havu, vehacha la. ella, i la degalle botzina kaddisha beatreh, la itztarichna legallaa.
Patach veamar, (Chagai 2:8) li hakkesef veli hazzahav neum Adonai, hayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 115:16) hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai.

Bechamma atar istakkalna beillen mane dekudesha, dichtiv, (Vayikra 15) bigde kodesh hem, uchetiv, (Shemot 28:4) veasu bigde kodesh. may kedushsha hacha. ella hachi taninan, kedushsha inun bechol atar. uchetiv bigde kodesh hem. veasita bigde kodesh, kegavvna dilela.

Detanya kohen gadol leela, kohen gadol letatta, levushin dikar leela, levushin dikar letatta. uma dela amar kesef unechoshet, leatar ochora istalliku. dichtiv (Shemot 27:18) kol ammude hechatzer saviv mechushakim kasef vegomer, uchetiv veadnehem nechoshet. deinun mane shimmusha, leishtammasha mashkena behu.

Aval hacha beillen levushin dikar, la bae leishtammasha behu bar nash ochora, bar mikkahana rabba, dirvu meshach kudesha al resheh. dichtiv (Shemot 28:2) veasita bigde kodesh leaharon achicha lechavod uletifaret. divinun levushin dame legavvna dilela.
Tanya. vayyikrevu yeme yisrael lamut. amar ribbi yehuda, vavy lealma, deha bene nasha la chaman vela shemaan, vela
433: Yadin deha kol yoma veyoma, kala decharoza ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Tana alma chada, ishtemoda leela. vechad karoza nafik, hahu alma mizdazea umitchalchela. nafke (162 amud bet) teren tzipporin, deistallaku mehahu alma, dimdorehon techot ilana dechezu dechayye umota beh.
Nafka chad tzippora listar daroma vechad tzippora listar tzafona, vechad tzippora kad nahir yemama, vechad kad itchashach yemama. kol chad vechad kare umachreza, ma deshamin mehahu karoza.

Levatar bau leistallaka leatrayyhu, umishtamte raglayyhu benukeva dithoma rabba, umitlakkedan begavveh, ad deitpelig lelya. kad itpelig lelya, karoza kare, (Kohelet 9:12) vechatztzipporim haachuzot bappach kahem yukashim bene haadam.

Amar ribbi yehuda, beshata demitlakkedan ragloy divne nasha, veyomoy itkerivu, hahu yoma, itkere yom Adonai, leatava rucheh leh. tana behahi shata, pakda hahu kitra kaddisha, al rucheh. uman ihu, dichtiv, (Tehillim 90:10) yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana. vehi kitra sheviaa decholla.

Veim missitra digvura koote, ketiv, veim bigvurot shemonim shana dechitra digvura teminaa have, mikkan ulehala, let atar leitmeshach, kema deat amer, verahbam amal vaavn. beatar dela have yesoda, binyayna la itkeyyaym.

Amar ribbi yehuda, zakkain inun tzaddikaya, kad kudesha berich hu baa leatava rucheh leh, uleshaava hahu rucha begavveh. detanya, beshata dekudesha berich hu baa leatava rucheh leh, i zakkaa hu hahu rucha, ma ketiv, (Kohelet 12:7) veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah.

Vei la ishtakkach zachaa, vavy lehahu rucha, devae leistachaa benura dedalik, uleittakkana begin leishtaava begufa demalka vei la ittakkanat, vavy lehahu rucha, demitgalgela keavna bekosfita, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala. tanya, i hahu rucha zache, kamma tavin genizin leh behahu alma. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo.

Amar ribbi yose, kad hahu bar nash itkerivu yomoy, telatin yomin machrize aloy bealma veafillu tzippore shemaya machrizin aloy. vei zakkaa hu, telatin yomin machrizin aloy ben tzaddikaya, beginta deeden.

Tana, kol inun telatin yomin, nishmateh nafkat minneh bechol lelya, vesalkat vechamat duchetah behahu alma, vehahu bar nash la yada, vela ashgach, vela shallit benishmateh, kol inun telatin yomin kema dehava bekadmita. dichtiv, (Kohelet 8:8) en adam shallit baruach lichlo et haruach vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda, mikkad sharan inun telatin yomin, tzalma debar nash itchashach, vediukena deitchaze beara itmenaat.
Ribbi yitzchak hava yativ yoma chad afitcha deribbi yehuda, vehava atziv. nafik ribbi yehuda, ashkecheh letareh, dehava yativ veatziv. amar leh (120 45) man yoma den mishshear yomin.

Amar leh, atena legabbach, lemive minach telat millin, chad, dechad tema mille deorayyta, vetadkar meinun millin deana amina, detema lon mishshemi, begin leadkara shemi. vechad detizke leyosef beri beorayyta. vechad, detezil lekivri kol 7 yomin, vetive bautich alay.

Amar leh minnayin lach. amar leh, ha nishmati istallekat mini bechol lelya, vela anhir li bechelma kema dehava bekadmita. veod dechad ana matzlena umatina leshomea tefilla, ashgachna betzulemi dili bechotla, vela chamina leh. veamina dehoil vetzalma itavar vela itchaze, deha karoza nafik vechariz. dichtiv, (Tehillim 39:7) ach betzelem yithallech ish, kol zimna detzulema devar nash la yitavar minneh, yithallech ish, verucheh itkayyeyma begavveh. itavar tzulema devar nash vela itchaze, itavar mehay alma.
Amar leh, umehacha, dichtiv, (Iyov 8:9) ki tzel yamenu ale aretz. amar leh, kol illen millin deat bae avidna. aval baina minach
434: Divhahu alma, tevarir duchetay gabbach, kema dahavena behay alma. bacha ribbi yitzchak veamar, bematu minach, dela titparesh minnay kol illen yomin.

Azlu legabbeh deribbi shimon, ashkechuhu dehava lae beorayyta, zakif enoy ribbi shimon, vechama leribbi yitzchak, vechama lemalach hammavet derahit kammeh, verakid kammeh. kam ribbi shimon, achid bideh deribbi yitzchak. amar, gozarna, man deragil lemeal, yeul. uman dela ragil lemeal, la yeul. alu ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda, katir malach hammavet levar.

Ashgach ribbi shimon, vechama dead kean la mata iddana, deha ad temanya shate deyoma hava zimna. otveh kamme ribbi shimon, vehava lae leh beorayyta. amar rabbi shimon leribbi elazar berih, tiv afitcha uma (120 uman) detechome, la tishtae bahadeh. vei yive lemeal hacha, ome omaa dela leol.

Amar ribbi shimon leribbi yitzchak, chamit diukena deavuch yoma da, o la. deha taninan, beshata devar nash istallak mealma, avoy vekrevoy mishtakkechin tamman immeh, vechama lon veishtemoda lon, vechol inun dehava medoreh gabbayyhu behahu alma bedarga chad, kullehu mitkanneshe umishtakkeche immeh, veazlin im nishmateh, ad atar detishre beatreh. amar, ad kean la chamena.

Addehachi kam ribbi shimon veamar, mare dealma, ishtemoda ribbi yitzchak legabban, umeinnun shiva ayynin dehacha hu. ha achidna beh, vehav li. nafak kala veamar, kuresyay (sefer acher taseyseh) demareh keriva begadfoy deribbi shimon, ha didach hu, veimmach tayyteh bezimna detiol lemishre bechuresyach. amar ribbi shimon, vadday.

Addehachi, chama ribbi elazar dehava istallik malach hammavet. veamar, let kufetra detifsa, beatar deribbi shimon ben yochay shechiach. amar ribbi shimon leribbi elazar bereh, ul hacha, veachid beh beribbi yitzchak, deha chamena beh demistafe. al ribbi elazar, veachid beh. veribbi shimon ahadar anpeh velae beorayyta.

Nayim ribbi yitzchak, vechama leavoy. amar leh, beri, zakkaa chulakach bealma den uvealma deate. deha ben tarpe ilana dechayye deginta deeden, ityehiv (et yativ) ilana rabba vetakkif bitren almin, ribbi shimon ben yochay hu. deha hu achid lach beanfoy, zakkaa chulakach beri.

Amar leh abba, uma ana hatam. amar leh, telat yomin havu dechafu idra demishkavach. vetakkinu lach kevan petichan, leanhara lach mearba sitrin dealma. veana chamena duchetech vechadena, daamena zakkaa chulakach beri. bar dead kean, berach la zache beorayyta.

Veha hasheta have zeminin lemete gabbach, teresar tzaddikaya dechavrayay, vead dahavena nafke, itar kala bechullehu almin, man chavrin (sefer acher shevilin) dekayymin hacha, itataru, begineh deribbi shimon. sheelta shail, veityeyhiv leh.

Vela da bilchodoy, deha shivin duchete mitatteran hacha dileh. vechol ducheta veducheta, patchin petichan leshivin almin. vechol alma vealma itpattach le rehitin. vechol rehita urehita, itpattach leshivin kitrin illain. umittamman itpattachu archin leattika setimaa decholla, lemecheme behahu neimuta illaa denahara, umehanya lecholla. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. mahu ulevakker behechalo. hayeynu dichtiv, (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu.

Amar leh, abba, kamma zimna yehivu li behay alma, amar leh, let li reshuta vela modae leh levar nash. aval behillula rabba deribbi shimon, tehe metakken patoreh. kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo imo beyom chatunnato uveyom simchat libbo.
Addehachi itar ribbi yitzchak, vehava chayich, veanpoy nehirin. chama ribbi shimon, veistakkel beanpoy. amar leh, milla chadta shemata. amar leh, vadday. sach leh, ishtattach kammeh deribbi shimon.
435: Ribbi yitzchak achid livreh bideh, velae leh beorayyta, vela hava shavkeh. kad hava al kammeh deribbi shimon, otveh livreh levar, veyativ kammeh deribbi shimon, vehava kare kammeh (Yeshayahu 38:14) Adonai ashka li arveni.

Tana, behahu yoma takkifa udechilu devar nash, kad mate zimneh leistallaka mealma, arba sitrin dealma kayymin bedina takkifa, umitarin dinin mearba sitre alma. vearba kishshurin natzan, uketatuta ishtakkach benayyhu, uvayayn leitperasha kol chad lesitroy.
Karoza nafik umachreza behahu alma, veishtema bematan veshivin almin. i zakkaa hu, kullehu almin chadan lekadamuteh. vei lav, vavy lehahu bar nash ulechulakeh.
Tana, behahu zimna decharoza kariz, keden nafak chad shalhova missetar tzafon, veazla veittokad binhar dinur, umitparsha learba sitre alma, veokid nishmathon dechayyayvaya.
Venafak hahu shalhova, vesalka venachata bealma. vehahu shalhova mata begadfoy detarnegola uchema, uvatash begadfoy, vekare befitcha ben tare.

Zimna kadmaa kare veamar, (Malachi 3:19) hinne yom Adonai ba boer kattannur vegomer. zimna tinyayna kare veamar, (Amos 4:13) ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach umaggid leadam ma secho. vehahi shaatta, yativ bar nash beovadoy, desahadin kammeh, vehu ode alayyhu. zimna telitaa, kad bayayn leafaka nishmateh minneh, kare tarnegola veamar, (Yirmeyahu 10:7) mi lo yiraacha melech haggoyim ki lecha yaata vegomer.

Amar ribbi yose, tarnegola uchema lemay nafka. amar leh ribbi yehuda, kol ma deavad kudesha berich hu beara, kullehu ramiz bechachma, bar divne nasha la yade. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyanecha, umishshum deitavidu bechachma, kullehu remizin bechachma.

Vetarnegola uchema, taninan, let dina sharya ella beatar dehu zinih. veuchema missitra dedina kaate. uvegin kach, befalgut lelya mammash, kad rucha desitra detzafon itar, chad shalhova nafik, uvatash techot gadfoy detarnegola, vekare. vechol shekken betarnegola uchema, deitkavvevn yattir meachara.

Uf hacha, beshata dedina devar nash yitar, share vekare leh, velet deyada leh, bar hahu bar nash deshachiv. detaninan, beshata devar nash shachiv, vedina sharya aleh lenafka mehay alma, ittosaf rucha illaa beh, ma dela hava beyomoy. vechevan desharya aloy veitdabbak beh, chame ma dela zacha beyomoy, mishshum deittosaf beh hahu rucha. vechad ittosaf beh vechama, keden nafik mehay alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:29) tosef rucham yigvaun veel afaram yeshuvun. keden ketiv, (Shemot 33:20) ki lo yirani haadam vachay, bechayyehon la zachan, bemitathon zachan.

Tana, beshata devar nash mit, ityehiv leh reshuta lemecheme, vechame gabbeh kerivoy vechavroy mehahu alma, veishtemoda lehu. vechullehu gelifin bediukenehon kema dehavu behay alma. i zakkaa hahu bar nash, kullehu chadan kammeh, umakdeme leh shelam.

Vei zakkaa la have, la ishtemodan gabbeh, bar meinun chayyayvaya, detardin lon bechol yoma baggehinnam. vechullehu atzivin, ufatchin bevavy umesayyeymin bevavy. vesalik enoy, vechama lon ketisa demistalleka min nura, uf hachi, hu patach, vavy.

Tanya, beshata denafak nishmateh devar nash, azlin kullehu kerivoy vechavroy dehahu alma im nishmateh, umachzeyayn leh atra deidduna, veatra deonasha. i zakkaa havi, chame ducheteh, vesalik veyativ, veitadan beidduna illaa dehahu alma. vei la have zakkaa, ishtearat hahi nishmata behay alma, ad deitamir gufa beara. kevan deitamar, kamma gardinin denimmusin achadan beh, ad demata leduma, vealin leh bemadoroy degehinnom.
Amar ribbi yehuda, kol 7 yomin, nishmata azla mibbeteh lekivreh, umikkivreh leveteh, veitabbalat aloy
436: Degufa. dichtiv, (Iyov 14:22) ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval. azla veyatva beveteh, chame lechullehu atzivin umitabbela.

Tana, batar 7 yomin, gufa have kema dehava, venishmateh alat leducheta, alat limarta dechafelta, chamat ma dechamat, vealat leatar dealat, ad dematat legan eden, vearat lichruvim, veshanan decharba di began eden diltatta. i zakkaa hu deteul, alat.

Tana, arba samchin zeminin, vechad diukena degufa bidayyhu, (Shemot 210 amud alef) mitlabbesha beh bechedvavta veyativat behahu madora degan eden diltatta, ad zimna deitgezar alah. levatar keroza kare.

Veammuda ditlat gevavne izdamman, vehahu ammuda itkere, mechon har tziyyon dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:Adonai) uvara Adonai al mechon har tziyyon veal mikraeha anan yomam veashan vegomer. salka behahu ammuda lefitcha detzedek, detziyyon virushalam beh.

I zache lesalka yattir, tav chulakeh veadveh, leitdabbeka bego gufa demalka. vei la zache lesalleka yattir, ketiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalam kadosh yeamer lo. vei zache lesalka yattir, zakkaa hu. dezache likara demalka, uleitaddena beidduna illaa, dilela meatar deikre shamayim. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titanneg al Adonai, al Adonai dayyka. zakkaa chulakeh deman dezache lechesed da, dichtiv, (Tehillim 108:5) ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha.

Vechi al hashshamayim hu, veha ketiv, (Tehillim 57:11) ki gadol ad shamayim chasdecha. amar ribbi yose, it chesed, veit chesed. chesed illaa, vechesed tattaa. chesed illaa meal shamayim hu. chesed tattaa, hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 55:3) chasde david hanneemanim, uvehanne ketiv ad shamayim.

Tanya, amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha halleluya, imma yedia, habbanim man inun. amar ribbi shimon, ha taninan, teren benin it lekudesha berich hu, chad dechar vechad nukeva. dechar, yahaveh leyaakov, dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni bechori yisrael, uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaer. bat, yahavah leavraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:1) vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol, bat hayta lo leavraham, uvakkol shema.

Veima revia alayyhu, deyanka lehu, veal hay ketiv, (Devarim 104) lo tikkach haem al habbanim. vetaninan, la yasge bar nash chovoy letatta, begin deyistallak imma meal benin. uchetiv, (Vayikra 18:7) immecha hi lo tegalle ervatah, vavy leman degale eryayta.

Vechad tayyvin bene alma, veasgin bizchuta kamme kudesha berich hu, veimma tavat vechasya al benin, keden itkere teshuva. may teshuva. da teshuva deimma, detavat bekiyyumaha, ucheden (Shemot 83 amud alef) ketiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha, em habbanim vadday. veal da, la lippatar inish mipperiyya ureviyya, ad deolid ben uvat.

Tanya amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo, tiuveta detzaddikaya lemecheme da, (15 33 noam Adonai) veat amart al Adonai. amar ribbi shimon, kolla chad. mashma dichtiv noam Adonai, deatya meattika kaddisha lehay shamayim. vetiuveta detzaddikaya kach hu vadday, veal hashshamayim ketiv, az titanneg al Adonai. zakkaa chulakeh man dezache. vadday zeirin inun.

Taninan, amar rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:6) bene immi nicharu vi samuni notera et hakkeramim, bene immi, kema dichtiv, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz, dechad baa kudesha berich hu lemechrava beteh diltatta, uleaglaa yisrael bene ammaya. aavar kudesha berich hu mikkammeh lehay eretz, veitrachaka minnih. kedichtiv, (Shemot 2:4) vattetatztzav achoto merachok. vechad hay eretz itrachaka mishshamayim dilela, hay eretz diltatta itcharva, veyisrael itpazzeru beni ammaya, amra keneset yisrael, man garim li hay uman avid li hay, bene immi denicharu vi, veitrachaku minni, beni immi vadday.
Ribbi yose hava azil bearcha, vehava immeh ribbi chiyyay bar rav. ad dehavu azle, amar ribbi yose leribbi chiyyay, chameta ma deana chamit. amar leh, chamena gavra chad benahara, vetzippora chad al
437: Resheh, veila befumeh detzippora, veachla verafsa beragloy, vehahu gevar rame kalin vetzavavch, vela yedana may kaamar.

Amar, nikrav gabbeh venishma. amar, mistafina lemikrav. amar leh, vechi bar nash hu beatar da, ella remiza dechachmeta deramiz lan kudesha berich hu. kerivu gabbeh, shamu dehava amar, otra otra, teren benin sharyayn levar, (sefer acher sheriu levara) la nach vela nayycha, ad detzafra bekisra remiv.
Bacha ribbi yose veamar, hayeynu detaninan, bene immi nicharu vi vegomer, may tama. begin decharmi shelli lo natarti.

Amar, vadday galuta itmeshach, veal da (sefer acher di) tzippore shemaya la aadiu, ad di shaltanuta deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot aadiu min alma. veematay, ad deyimte yoma dekudesha berich hu itar dinoy bealma. dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:7) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai lo yom velo layla.
Ad dehavu azlin, shamu chad kala dehava amar, okida dekufetira mata bedinoy, nafak chad shalhova, veokid lehahu tzippora. amar, vadday, kema dichtiv, (Daniel 7:11) vihivat likedat eshsha.

Amar ribbi yose, la agle kudesha berich hu leyisrael, ella bezimna dela ishtakkach mehemnuta benayyhu. kad itmena mehemnuta benayyhu, kivyachol, hachi ishtakkach becholla. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 28:18) vechipper beritchem et mavet.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, may dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach. amar leh, kad yitar kudesha berich hu yemina dileh, itmena mota min alma. vela yitar hay yemina, ella kad yitarun yisrael bimina dekudesha berich hu, umay nihu tora, dichtiv bah, (Devarim 33:21) mimino esh dat lamo. behahu zimna, (Tehillim 118:17) yemin Adonai osa chayil vegomer, lo amut ki echye vaasapper maase yah.

Tana, hahu zakkaa dekudesha berich hu itrae beh, vecharoza kare aleh, 30 yomin, bene tzaddikayay beginta deeden. kullehu tzaddikaya chadan, kullehu tzaddikayay atyayn, umeatteran ducheteh dehahu tzaddika, ad deyete lemedar diyyureh benayyhu.
Vei chayyayva hu, karoza kare aleh baggehinnam telatin yomin (aleh), vechullehu chayyayvaya, kullehu atzivin.

Kullehu patchin vavy, deha dina chadta itar hasheta, begineh diflanya. kamma gardinin denimmusin mizdammenin lekovleh, uleakdama leh vavy. oy larasha oy lishcheno. vechullehu patchin veamrin, (Yeshayahu 3:11) oy lerasha ra ki gemul yadav yease lo. may (tama) gemul yadav. amar ribbi yitzchak. leachlala (leappaka) man dezane bidoy, leafaka ulechabbela zareh berekanya (69 amud alef).

Deha taninan, kol man deappik zareh berekanya, ikre ra, vela chame appe shechinta. dichtiv, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra. uchetiv, (Bereshit 38:7) vayhi er bechor yehuda ra. uf hacha, oy lerasha ra. vavy lehahu chayyayva deihu ra, deavad garmeh ra. ki gemul yadav yease lo, leachlala man dezane bidoy, leafaka ulechabbela zareh verekanya, ulehay tardin behahu alma yattir mikkolla.

Ta chaze, deha ketiv oy lerasha (270), kevan dichtiv oy lerasha, ammay ra. ela kema deamina, deavad garmeh ra. uchetiv lo yegurecha ra. vechullehu salkin, vehay la salik. vei tema, shear chayyayvin dekatlu bene nasha. ta chaze, kullehu salkin vehu la salik. may tama, inun ketilu bene nasha ochora, vehay katil benoy mammash, oshid damin saggiin. ta chaze, bishar chayyayve alma, la ketiv vayyera beene Adonai, vechan ketiv, vayyera beene Adonai asher asa. may tama, mishshum dichtiv veshichet artza.

Tenan, amar ribbi yehuda, let lach chova bealma dela it leh teshuva, bar mehay. velet lach chayyayvaya dela chaman appe shechinta, bar mehay. dichtiv lo yegurecha ra, kelal. amar ribbi yitzchak, zakkain inun tzaddikayay, bealma den uvealma deate. alayyhu ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz. may leolam yirshu aretz, amar ribbi yehuda, kema dichtiv, (tehillim 115) ethallech lifne Adonai beartzot hachayyim:
Vaychi yaakov (shayych Vayikra 104 amud bet) begavvayyhu. (106 nimtza 13 baddaf 50 ammud 199) al da libbae leh levar nash dela leitarva tzulema dileh
438: Betzulema deoved kochavim umazzalot, begin dehay kaddisha vehay mesaava.

Ta chaze, ma ben yisrael leamin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. deyisrael kad ishtakkach bar nash mit hu mesaav lechol gufa, uveta mesaava. vegufa deoved kochavim umazzalot la masiv leochora, vegufeh (nusach acher uveta) la mesaava kad ihu mit. may tama.
Yisrael beshata deihu mit kol kiddushe demareh mitavran minneh, itavar minneh hay tzulema kaddisha, veitavar minneh hay ruach kudesha, ishtaar gufa mesaava.

Aval oved kochavim umazzalot oved avoda zara, let hachi. divchayye mesaav bechol sitrin, tzulema dileh mesaava, verucha dileh mesaava. uvegin desoavute illen sharyayn begavveh, asir lemikrav legabbeh. kevan demit, nafke kol illen mesaavuta veishtaar gufa bela mesaavuta lesoava.

Veaf al gav degufa dilhon mesaav, ben bechayyehon uven bemitathon. aval bechayyehon dechol inun mesaavin ishtakkeche legabbayyhu, it lon chela lesoava leacharini, bemitathon denafke kol inun mesaavin minnayyhu, la yachlin lesaava. udeyisrael, yachil lesaava leacharine. begin dechol kaddishin nafkin minneh veshara aleh sitra ochora.

Ta chaze, hay tzelem kaddisha, chad azil bar nash veitrabbe, veitavid mehay partzufa diukena dileh. itavid tzulema ochora, umitchabberan kechada. veda natil leda, beshata deishtakkechu teren tzulemin, natir hu bar nash, vegufa dileh bekiyyuma, verucheh sharya begavveh.
Beshata dekarivu yomoy, mitavran minneh, veda salik leda, veishtaar bar nash bela netiru. keden, (Shir HaShirim 2:17) ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim, tere.

Ta chaze, kad itar dina bealma, dekudesha berich hu yativ al karse dedina lemedan alma, bae bar nash leatara (bedina) teshuva, deyetuv mechiyyuva (nusach acher mechovoy). deha hahu yoma, pitkin ketivu, umishtakkeche kullehu beachmata ha chetivin. i zache bar nash deyetuv kamme mareh, karin pitkin dealeh.
Levatar kudesha berich hu zammin kammeh debar nash, yoma dechippure yoma ditshuva. i tav mechetoy tav. vei la, pakkid malka lemichtam pitkin. vavy, deha teshuva baya leistallaka minneh.

I zache bitshuva, vela shelemata kedka yeut, talyayn leh ad hahu yoma batraa daatzeret, dehu teminaa lechag. vei avad teshuva shelemata lekamme mareh, itkerau. vei la zache, inun pitkin nafkin mibbe malka, veitmasseran bidoy desantira, vedina mitavid, ufitkin la mehadderan tu leve malka.

Keden tzulemin itavaru minnih, vela mishtakkechin immeh. kevan demitavran minneh, ha vadday tufeska demalka yaavor aleh, veyitom kassa demota. uvehahu lelya dechagga batraa, santerin zeminin, ufitkin natlin, batar denatle lon, tzulemin mitavran, vela mishtakkechin (nusach acher vei mishtakkechin gareyayn yaavor aloy marin vechulei) behu yade. vei mishtakkechin behu yade (yaade), dina geria, o yaavor aloy dina marin bishin, bigriuta dilhon, veha okimna leha.

Uvesifre kadmae amre yattir, kad resha igra, veyishtakkach gufa. bereh, o inteteh yishtakkachu vehu yistallek. vehani mile, kad la ahadar kol hahu zimna bityuveta. aval i ahadar, taama demota yitam, veyittese.
Vei gufa la itchaze, veyishtakkach resha. inun salkin, vehu itkayyem. vehane mile, kad bereh zeera birshuteh.

Vei yedoy pegimu, avidta didoy pegimin. ragloy, marin radfin aleh. arak tzulema veahadar, arak veahadar. aleh ketiv, (Devarim 28:67) babboker tomar mi yitten erev, vehay kad nahara sihara, velelya ittakkan binhora.

Aval zakkae chaside, bechol yoma veyoma mistakkele belibbayyhu, keillu hahu yoma mistalleke mealma, veavdin teyuveta shelemata kamme marehon, vela yitztarchun lemilla ochora. zakkaa chulekehon bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, (Yeshayahu 43:7) kol hannikra bishmi, kamma illain ovade malka kaddisha, deha beinun ovade (nusach acher biryayn) deihu avid letatta katir lon bemillin illain dilela, vechad natlin lon letatta veavde behu ovada, itar hahu ovada dilela dekatir bah. kegon ezova, etz erez, veha okimna
439: Veit minnayyhu deachidan bishma kaddisha, kegon (Vayikra 24 amud alef) lulav, veetrog, hadas, vaarava, dechullehu achidan bishma kaddisha leela. veal da taninan, leachada lon, ulemebad behu ovada, begin leitara chedva hahu deachid beh. veal da taninan, bemillin veovada bayayn leachazaa milla, begin leitara milla ochora.
Hada hu dichtiv, kol hannikra bishmi velichvodi (berativ), leatara yekari. berativ, leyaychada li. yetzartiv, lemebad beh ovada (nusach acher chela). af asitiv, leatara beh chela dilela.
Davar acher, kol hannikra bishmi, hayeynu dichtiv (Vayikra 23:40) peri etz hadar. velichvodi berativ, hayeynu kappot temarim. yetzartiv, hayeynu vaanaf etz avot. af asitiv, hayeynu vearve nachal.
Vetikkuna dehay deamar kera, (Vayikra 23:40) ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon, dayyka. dehu chamishaa al asor.
Aval bayyom harishon, hahu yom rishon man hu. ella yom denafik rishon, lenatla (davar acher lecholla) bemabbuoy demayin neviin, veanan bayayn leamshacha leh lealma.

Metal lemalka dekatar bene nasha bekitroy, immeh matronita atat, vaafikat lon lecherut, umalka ashgach likara dilah, veyahav lon bidaha. ashkachat lon kayyfin vetzachin, amarat, ha afikat lon lecheru, ayyte lon mechla umishtayyay.

Kacha, ha yom hakkippurim appik lecholla lecheru, veanan kafni mezona kaimna, vetzachinan lemishtayya, hi aatarat lemalka beitteroy. behay yoma yedana, deha mayin neviin immah sharyayn, shailna lemishtayyay, leman deappik lon lecheru. veal da karinan leh yom rishon.
Da besifra deaggadta veshappir hu. aval behay yoma, leavraham sheruta decholla, i baanane yekar hu sheruta, i bemaya hu sheruta. deavraham share lemechperi beyiri demaya.

Peri etz hadar, da bera deyitzchak, deyitzchak ahadar leh lekudesha berich hu vekara leh etz hadar. peri dehay etz hadar yedia. kappot temarim, dichtiv, (Tehillim 92:13) tzaddik kattamar yifrach, vela ishtakkach benayyhu piruda. veal da la ketiv vechappot, ella kappot. begin dela salik da bela da, uvehay itmalyay hay beer, mibbeer mayim illain neviin, hahu itmalle bekadmita, uminneh itmalyay bera, ad deihu neviu lecholla.

Vaanaf etz avot, da anafa deilana ravreva, deatkif veishtarsha besharshoy, itavid ilana illaa al kolla, deachid bechol sitreh, anaf deihu etz avot, etz deachid leavot, deha mehay natal yesoda dealma, veitmalleya laaraka bevera, hay hu alma araka deshakyuta.

Vearve nachal, tere inun, teren nachalin demayyay itkenish behu, laaraka latztzaddik. davar acher, vearve nachal, illen inun gevuran, deachidan beh beyitzchak, deatyayn missitra dehahu nachal illaa, vela missitra deabba. vegin kach, kolla yae, vela besima leferin, vela avid perin.
Vearve nachal, teren keyaymin, degufa kayyma alayyhu, aval vearve nachal vadday, kema deittemar, veillen inun kullehu laaraka mayyay levera.
Davar acher, ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon peri etz hadar, da avraham. kappot temarim, da yitzchak. vaanaf etz avot, da yaakov. vearve nachal, illen inun teren dargin deamaran.

Uman dematne hay, begin deetz avot da yaakov, deachid lechullehu chalakin, vadday da yaakov. aval ha okimna, peri etz hadar da bera deyitzchak, da gevura tattaa. kappot temarim. kappot chaser, kishshura deitkashshar bevera, kema deat amer, (Daniel 3:21) kefitu besarbalehon, begin deillen la salkin da bela da. vaanaf etz avot, anafa hu illaa, deitavid etz avot, veachid lechol sitra, kema deittemar. arve nachal da yitzchak, bechol sitre, deachidan besitra denachala, vela besitra deabba. detaninan, af al gav divhay nachal dina la ishtakkach beh, dinin mitarin minneh.

Verav hamenuna sava parish, vearve nachal, inun teren kayymin dekaamaran, demayyay nafke minnayyhu, veshappir. aval ta chaze, ha chazinan ditren dargin illen dekayyme al darga detzaddik, ibba uchenishu ravreva (sefer acher devirkan) nafke minnayyhu, vearve nachal la nafke minnayyhu, ibba, vela tama, vela recha. veha okimna vecholla shappir.
